title: Transfer one named staff responsibility with protected intent and truthful history
delivers: Staff can replace, end or deliberately keep an exact role-qualified assignment, including explicit primary handling, without changing other roles, work or access.

blockers.contract: Canonical stored relationship/catalog primitives with staff-family role-aware identity

Manual replacement/removal and Keep are protected intent; same-person Keep is not an assignee no-op. Preserve N assignees per role and multiple roles per person, one valid primary, end-dated prior facts, current-authorized receipt recovery and new attributed correction/return. Census the reached legacy fields and fence incompatible writers before accepting this new source state. If affected independent-work validity cannot be proved, expose a safe blocked source repair rather than claim completion; A05 later qualifies the concrete handoff paths.

non_goals: No generic graph editor replacement (#625 owns it), rule evaluator, automatic transfer, new primary heuristic, historical identity rewrite, grant change or automatic transfer of partnership/Request/task ownership.

acceptance: AC27-A03-01: Given one staff person holds two roles for one Party and multiple staff legitimately share a role; When one named responsibility is transferred, a duplicate copy or cross-Tenant reference is attempted, and a target already holding a compatible assignment is encountered; Then Same staff/Party can hold distinct roles; replacing one does not erase the other. Duplicate same-role source identities and cross-tenant references fail at admitted database paths.

AC27-A03-02: Given a current primary and several assignments, plus a separate case losing its final eligible assignee; When independent source connections concurrently change primary, replace an assignment or remove responsibility; Then Concurrent primary/replacement/removal produces one valid source result or conflict; primary remains a valid assignee, or the source's honest unassigned/repair state is used.

AC27-A03-03: Given legacy missionary assignment, role membership, a generic Owner display and saved portfolio views coexist with canonical assignment edges; When every supported assignment writer and read projection identifies or changes staff responsibility; Then No writer or read model treats legacy missionary ID, membership role, display Owner or a saved portfolio view as P9 assignment authority.

AC27-A03-04: Given ended assignments, previous manual protections and intervening later decisions exist; When a permitted reader inspects history or authorized staff correct responsibility and later return to a previously assigned person; Then Ended assignments and prior manual protections retain lawful actor/time/role history; correction and return are new transitions, not edits to historical identity.

AC27-A09-02: Given a caller may reach an existing row but may not produce every possible resulting assignment state; When direct admitted-role and service-path updates attempt forbidden Tenant, subject, recipient, role, control or scope changes; Then A permitted old-row update cannot create an unauthorized new tenant, subject, recipient, role, control state or scope; effective USING/WITH CHECK, grants and bypass paths are proved.

AC27-A10-01: Given a valid transfer includes required assignment, control, primary, history, receipt and durable effect intent; When failure is injected before authoritative commit, then in a separate case after commit but before projection publication; Then Fault injection before authoritative commit proves assignment/control/primary/history/receipt/effect intent all-or-none; after-commit projection failure preserves source truth.

AC27-A11-01: Given a transfer was accepted but its response was lost, followed by a later valid assignment or protection change; When the original intent is retried and a distinct later legitimate transfer is subsequently requested; Then Retrying a lost response returns the same current-authorized operation result and creates one business effect; a later legitimate transfer remains possible.

Ordinary replacement and intentional unassignment persist protected control from the first accepted write; Keep records a meaningful control change even for the same person. A future qualified automated command cannot bypass that source guard.

One normal save returns a truthful current result or a recoverable conflict. Unauthorized target existence/counts and raw constraint errors are not disclosed; inaccessible picker content never makes a persisted owner look absent.

Direct admitted-role and privileged-path tests enforce required tenant/role/revision references, current old-to-new authority, duplicate-role constraints, at-most-one primary, all-or-none history/receipt and safe source-work handling.
testing: Use real authenticated manual commands plus actual DB role/grant/RLS and independent-connection primary races. Inject precommit and postcommit projection failures and lost replies; verify one original result and later distinct correction. Cover record controls by browser/keyboard and preserve unrelated responsibilities. Carry provenance/role compatibility tests in this slice. Every listed command is verified in the current repository manifest/config; commands were not executed during ticket preparation. Configure disposable local real-role fixtures and fail preflight when required sources/auth are absent. Use the actual supported database release. Preserve build/schema/source/policy/fixture versions and red/green evidence.
constraints: Use current Bun/Turborepo/Next.js/shared API boundary and approved TanStack collections/hooks; exact Base UI/base-maia/Zinc UI. No Twenty, second portfolio/assignment store or alternative grant engine.

TDD at the already confirmed authenticated owner-command/projection/durable-worker seams over disposable Supabase; real staff/current contexts and a second tenant. Each slice implements its own relevant privacy, retry, migration compatibility and accessible failure behavior. Later cross-journey qualification consolidates evidence; it does not postpone those protections.

Maintain this slice’s REQ/AC/story/monitor-to-runtime evidence trace under REQ27-A18; implemented, qualified and activated remain separate. Completing local proof does not close the terminal cross-journey gates.

AC27-C15-03: Entity-wide giving is labeled correctly within a ministry partnership; unsupported purpose/campaign/recognition readers stay unavailable rather than guessed.
AC27-C15-04: Changing screen, current household membership, name, staff assignment or an unrelated donor cannot alter authoritative attribution or reveal another scope.
AC27-C16-01: USD, JPY and supported three-decimal amounts retain exact source units; processor costs, settlement conversion and tax benefits cannot move the original-currency band.

AC27-C16-02: Pending handoffs, unposted ACH, promises, match expectancies, monthly equivalents, securities valuations and liquidation do not add monetary occurrences/amounts; an admitted posted provisional check follows source truth.
AC27-C16-03: Prayer/hosting/introduction and recognition-only participation do not become a low-value relationship or adverse review solely from zero direct giving.
AC27-C16-04: A source-finance fact change is consumed through its owner; rating commands cannot post money, issue receipts, fulfill commitments or mutate payment execution.
AC27-C17-01: Known empty history produces frequency 0, amount 0 and nonnumeric no-qualifying-gift recency; incomplete/denied data does not produce those known-zero claims.
AC27-C17-02: For qualified roots in the period, independently computed exact root count, eligible monetary sum and calendar-day recency agree, including split/replay cases.
AC27-C17-03: A known older out-of-period gift is shown separately and never included in the period’s count/amount/recency.
AC27-C17-04: An unresolved eligible gift date/amount invalidates every affected axis without erasing independently complete facts or pretending full coverage.
AC27-C18-01: Leap-day/month-end fixtures produce the declared clamped lower boundary, exclude it, include the evaluation date and display matching inclusive dates.
AC27-C18-02: Future-dated evidence cannot create a completed gift or negative recency; an open fiscal period is labeled to-date and excludes later dates.
AC27-C18-03: Timezone travel and locale display do not shift source gift dates or fiscal boundaries; trailing months, fixed year, fiscal year and year-to-date stay distinct.

AC27-C20-01: Partial/full return, void and date correction produce the exact new count/amount/date while retaining history and explicit correction cause; unresolved refunds do not reduce posted money.
AC27-C20-02: Incomplete imports, permission loss, asynchronous recognition and source outages cannot become a zero/low band; independently complete axes remain accurate.
AC27-C20-03: Deduplication or identity correction does not double count roots, overwrite financial provenance or manufacture an adverse review episode.
AC27-C20-04: Known no gifts, inapplicable nonfinancial participation and missing source history are visibly distinct and independently testable.

requirement_contracts.title: Scope and composition
requirement_contracts.text:
P27 SHALL own one appeal coordination identity
and purpose. It SHALL reuse D24 membership and D22 Requests for financial,
nonfinancial and mixed support. It SHALL NOT require money or a numerical goal,
create a second request subtype per surface, or add an event, prayer-content,
volunteer, generic workflow or campaign-management engine.

requirement_contracts.title: Honest measures
requirement_contracts.text:
Each measure SHALL state its grain, scope, period,
current-versus-historical meaning and coverage. A working-list Party count SHALL
exclude historical-only participation; a current Request-response count SHALL
count distinct Requests using the source-qualified current response to identified
terms. Contradictory or unresolved accounts remain clarification-required and
SHALL NOT count as confirmed agreement.
A supporter with several response types MAY occur in each corresponding distinct-
supporter set: those sets SHALL NOT be summed as disjoint. Event counts SHALL be
explicitly labelled; repeat edits or replies SHALL NOT inflate current agreements.
Unavailable, withheld, incomplete, nonapplicable and known zero SHALL remain
different. Hidden rows SHALL be excluded before counting; a permission-safe view
must not reveal their existence through a total, difference, rank or small group.

A response rate SHALL use an explicit compatible invitation population, never
today's smaller working list after removals. Zero/absent target, denied denominator
and incomplete coverage SHALL not produce a percentage. Over-target actuals remain
visible rather than clipped to the goal. Goal revisions preserve their earlier
versions; current adjusted results and a dated closure snapshot are distinct views.

requirement_contracts.title: Financial truth
requirement_contracts.text:
P13 effective contribution lines, P14 qualified legal/
recognition lenses, P15 intake and P16 commitment/fulfillment SHALL remain the
authorities. A reference SHALL NOT allocate money or establish fulfillment. Every
amount SHALL retain Legal Entity, currency, amount basis, source identity, period
and freshness. Distinct source money SHALL be counted once within a financial
measure; overlapping appeal totals SHALL not be added as disjoint. No sum of legal
and recognition lenses, silent FX, invented valuation or gift inference from
names/dates/amounts/source code is allowed. Exact received-toward-appeal coverage
requires a qualified association adapter; otherwise label it unavailable while
retaining permitted source facts and ordinary nonfinancial work. Corrections,
returns and refunds SHALL change current derived outcomes through source truth,
without rewriting prior responses or adding another money writer.
Requested amounts, staff forecasts, supporter responses, commitments and received
money SHALL not be added together. Apply only admitted line/amount coverage, not
the full gift header because one portion is related. Preserve the qualified source
monetary basis, including admitted charitable fee cover and finalized corrections;
no processor-fee subtraction, expected gift, noncash valuation or liquidation
proceeds substitution. Readers SHALL use a coherent source/association/coverage
revision, not a maximum of unrelated per-record cursors.

requirement_contracts.title: Authority at every boundary
requirement_contracts.text:
The server SHALL derive tenant and actor
from trusted context; prove proposed owner, subject, source and purpose eligibility;
and reject caller-authored audit, approval, presentation or financial authority.
Appeal administration SHALL NOT grant finance, source Request, care, location,
missionary or historical access. Commands SHALL revalidate current authority and
expected revisions at their mutation boundary. Imports, jobs, RPCs, privileged
service paths, caches, search, exports, generated documents, briefs/AI and
notifications SHALL preserve the same field/purpose restrictions. D26's narrow
shared-update grant SHALL NOT become an appeal-audience grant.

requirement_contracts.title: Database safety
requirement_contracts.text:
Persisted identities/references SHALL have nonnull tenant
scope and tenant-aware referential integrity, protected audit attribution and
version/concurrency information. Optional money SHALL be genuinely absent for
nonfinancial work, not zero defaults; money uses exact currency-aware minor units
and supported bounds. Source monetary facts SHALL NOT be stored in independently
editable appeal totals. Enforce uniqueness of current membership/reference and
local valid-state/nullability constraints in the database where expressible;
cross-source compatibility and conservation belong to the qualified atomic owner
command. Check indexes for tenant/appeal/request lookup and every relevant FK.
Stable primary keys and required identity references SHALL be nonnull. Ordinary
commands SHALL not rewrite earlier meaningful response/terms versions; corrections
preserve prior meaning with attributed new history. History retention/deletion
SHALL follow source class, not blanket infinite storage.

Grants and policies SHALL prove both old-row eligibility (`USING`) and permitted
new state (`WITH CHECK` or its effective inherited equivalent), including tenant/
scope/owner/audience reassignment. Inspect permissive-policy combination, views,
function execution grants/search paths, service-role bypass and storage. PostgreSQL
can inherit `USING` as `WITH CHECK`; its absence in text is not alone a vulnerability.
RLS is not field authorization, and FK/unique errors can reveal hidden existence.
Use governed command access and safe conflict responses, not a UI-only check.

requirement_contracts.title: Private-by-scope participation
requirement_contracts.text:
Nonfinancial content SHALL follow its
classification and purpose. Do not collect prayer details, home addresses,
itineraries or private member-care notes just to coordinate an invitation.
Store only necessary source references and permitted summaries. General logs,
metrics, email notifications and broadly readable appeal headers SHALL NOT copy
that content. New attachments are not required by this decision; any retained
attachment reference uses its source's current access and retention, including
download links. Authorized correction/redaction and privacy deletion SHALL preserve
only lawful minimal provenance, not undeletable sensitive narratives.

requirement_contracts.title: Correctness under concurrency
requirement_contracts.text:
A mutation SHALL atomically persist its
authoritative intent, lawful history and required durable effect intent, or none.
Use semantic idempotency tied to the actual operation, not only an HTTP retry.
Identical retries return the same lawful result; stale competing edits conflict
without overwriting newer terms or responses. Link/unlink, close/reopen, merge,
suppression/revocation and dispatch races SHALL use current revisions/fences with
defined ordering. Cancellation of a finite bulk operation retains committed members
and truthfully identifies unattempted/failed ones. Lost responses and ambiguous
external success reconcile through the existing owner before resending. No unproved
exactly-once claim across external providers.

requirement_contracts.title: Temporal and correction meaning
requirement_contracts.text:
Preserve occurred-at precision separately
from server recorded-at, presented terms, current effective response and source
correction history. Do not fabricate dates or backdate permissions. A late response
or imported event SHALL not create historical outreach or replay old tasks. Purpose,
goal, financial applicability and reference edits SHALL preserve prior versions;
hiding a financial section SHALL not delete gifts or silently submit hidden values.
Source-qualified Party merge SHALL preserve conflicting planning/response facts
and financial donor history; unresolved collisions remain visible to authorized
repair staff without revealing hidden records or creating duplicates.

requirement_contracts.title: Coherent accessible interface
requirement_contracts.text:
The daily experience above SHALL preserve
shared design-system ownership, visible context, clear next actions, explicit
selection scope and truthful save/error/conflict feedback. Require WCAG 2.2 AA for
the composed flow, including keyboard/focus operation, text status announcements,
contrast, reflow and target size; do not mistake a shared primitive or axe pass for
complete accessibility. No drag-only financial/status mutation, compulsory wizard,
new dashboard language or donor-value rating. Current scope and relevant options
must be understandable without documentation or facilitator correction.

requirement_contracts.title: Bounded reads and integrations
requirement_contracts.text:
Page/virtualize authorized lists with
stable server ordering; compute aggregates from the qualified complete source set,
not loaded pages or capped timelines. Avoid per-row source fan-out and loading all
financial/private children for an overview. Bounded bulk work uses durable checkpoints
and per-member outcomes. Optional Studio, scoring, event/publishing tools and provider
outages SHALL NOT block ordinary authorized nonfinancial work. Source-dependent
features fail visibly without a shadow substitute. Any optimization is a rebuildable
read model with its source cursor/coverage, never a second writer.

requirement_contracts.title: Safe delivery and rollout
requirement_contracts.text:
Census retained records and active readers/
writers first; do not reinterpret legacy zero-valued gifts, campaign rows, task
completion or member statuses as nonfinancial outcomes. Preserve unknown historical
meaning. Introduce qualified readers/constraints before enabling writers and reject
incompatible old-client mutations. Backfills SHALL be resumable/idempotent and
produce no outward effects. Activate by bounded tenant/cohort with kill switches
for new writes/effects; rollback SHALL retain newly recorded history and favor
compatible reads/roll-forward over destructive downgrade. Reconcile formal owner
clauses and trace their tests before activation.

requirement_contracts.title: Evidence and operations
requirement_contracts.text:
Business history SHALL show who changed which
source terms, reference, response or disposition and when. Security audit tracks
authorized actions/access; technical logs track operation/correlation/source-version
IDs and failures without sensitive content. A saved authoritative response SHALL not
be lost because a projection failed; expose pending update and replay durable effects.
Release proof SHALL include real source services, real role/grant/RLS tests,
concurrent schedules, mixed-version migration and observed staff UX. Unknown workload
or usability cannot be replaced by a fabricated performance number or claim of
perfection. Every monitored residual has an owner, threshold and response below.

AC27-F40-01: Given duplicate candidate IDs and an existing visible or hidden membership, when executing simultaneous and repeated Add operations, then Duplicate candidate IDs, concurrent same-Party Add and already-in-list Add create at most one membership. AC27-F38-03: Given an accepted working list derived from a saved filter, when editing, deleting or refreshing that filter, then A saved-filter change never adds/removes an accepted entry. New discovery may show candidates, but does not resume excluded/removed work or alter actual outcomes.

AC27-F42-01: Given denied or unknown planning authority and an existing later-restricted entry, when attempting new inclusion and reading retained membership, then New inclusion fails safely when planning authority/eligibility is denied or unknown. An existing retained entry under later restriction is shown only within current rights and cannot authorize outreach; loading/error is not zero.

AC27-F42-02: Given genuinely empty, all-removed, all-restricted, wholly hidden and failed-query cases, when opening the working list and its counts/actions, then All entries removed, all currently restricted, no permitted entries, failed query and genuinely zero entries yield distinct truthful views/counts/actions within disclosure limits. AC27-F40-02: Given actual nonowner and privileged command/database paths, when attempting tenant/appeal/Party substitutions and forged provenance or forbidden new state, then Actual Tenant/appeal/Party substitution, forbidden resulting-row mutation, forged actor/provenance and capability-only/role-label shortcuts fail across API, RLS, functions, views and privileged writers without partial change or existence leak.

AC27-F38-04: Given retained list tags, actual asks, historical planning evidence and imports, when mapping canonical Parties and importing under current authority, then Imports/backfills distinguish evidenced prior planning from list tags/actual asks/consent, resolve canonical Parties under current authority, and never create current outreach or approvals from historical labels.

AC27-F42-04: Given restricted reasons and records plus exportable untrusted content, when reading counts, differences, caches, replay and exports after current rights change, then Counts/filter facets/difference queries, exports, caches, late responses after context switch, logs and result receipts respect row/field/purpose floors. Test formula/script injection, protected reasons and revoked export release/download.

AC27-F38-05: Given Studio and external campaign providers unavailable, when performing native planning and attempting external-list or saved-view synchronization writes, then Native appeal planning works with P34/P42 and external campaign providers unavailable. A saved view, giving campaign, workflow or provider list cannot write appeal membership by synchronization convention.

requirement_contracts.title: Recorded planning intent
requirement_contracts.text:
Appeal membership SHALL change only through
  qualified explicit source actions. Later filter/query changes SHALL NOT mutate
  an accepted working list or the intended population of an admitted operation.

requirement_contracts.title: Separate facts
requirement_contracts.text:
Planned inclusion, current eligibility, actual requests,
  responses, commitment, received money and communication outcomes SHALL retain
  their distinct source meanings. Membership SHALL create none of the other facts.

requirement_contracts.title: Stable scoped identity
requirement_contracts.text:
Each appeal SHALL have at most one current entry
  for the same qualified Party in its Tenant/source scope, with complete scoped
  references and retained provenance. Organizations SHALL NOT expand into recipients
  and weak matching SHALL NOT merge distinct people or organizations.

requirement_contracts.title: Deliberate dispositions
requirement_contracts.text:
Add, Remove, Exclude and Return SHALL follow the
  lifecycle table. Plain Add/import/retry SHALL skip retained removed/excluded
  entries; only an explicit currently authorized Return may restore inclusion.

requirement_contracts.title: Current authority
requirement_contracts.text:
Candidate discovery, counts, group capture, each member
  effect, history, result replay, export and outward use SHALL prove their current
  exact actor/field/purpose/source permissions. Assignment or membership SHALL grant
  none. Unknown authority SHALL NOT be treated as permission or zero coverage.

requirement_contracts.title: Current restrictions
requirement_contracts.text:
New actionable inclusion and solicitation SHALL
  respect current applicable never-ask/contact restrictions. Existing history SHALL
  not be rewritten or erased to represent current restriction. Appeal exclusions
  SHALL NOT be used to modify global consent, or bypassed through alternate contacts
  representing the same excluded organization/purpose.

requirement_contracts.title: Finite group intent
requirement_contracts.text:
A group operation SHALL bind exact intended identities,
  action and source scope, distinguish selected page/all results, and record a
  coherent bounded capture. It SHALL NOT recapture a changing filter on retry.

requirement_contracts.title: Atomic member outcomes
requirement_contracts.text:
Each accepted member effect, required local history,
  receipt and actual required producer-fence advancement/supersession SHALL be atomic
  through the qualified owner transaction. Only permitted secondary effects may be
  deferred through durable intent; a fence-update outbox alone is insufficient.
  Independent outcomes may be
  partial; accepted work SHALL survive other members' failures and cancellation.

requirement_contracts.title: Concurrency and idempotency
requirement_contracts.text:
Relevant expected heads and owner fences SHALL
  serialize competing state/authority changes. Same-intent retries SHALL not duplicate
  or reapply effects; changed intent SHALL conflict; old receipts SHALL not replace
  current membership. Ordinary Add SHALL not override a newer removal/exclusion.

requirement_contracts.title: Precise outward effect
requirement_contracts.text:
Solicitation whose qualified producer purpose
  depends on appeal working membership SHALL use continuing inclusion as a current
  producer predicate through P6/P32 before
  dispatch admission. Removal/exclusion SHALL fence affected not-yet-admitted work,
  preserve in-flight/unknown truth and never cancel independent owner work merely
  because it has an appeal link. Return
  SHALL not revive ended effects; absent adapter qualification SHALL block activation.

requirement_contracts.title: Existing work and historical facts
requirement_contracts.text:
List edits SHALL preserve actual
  requests/responses/financial facts. Historical entry remains possible without
  re-adding the Party. Source-backed tasks SHALL follow exact actionable predicates;
  membership, filter refresh and generic completion SHALL not start/end other facts.

requirement_contracts.title: Identity repair
requirement_contracts.text:
Merge/unmerge SHALL use owner-qualified identity repair,
  retained provenance and current restrictions. Conflicting applicable planning
  intentions SHALL not become silently actionable or double-counted; resolution is
  bounded to affected membership and respects later decisions.

requirement_contracts.title: Minimal governed data
requirement_contracts.text:
Store minimal classified membership/provenance and
  lawful history, with current source projections for contact detail. Manifests,
  reasons, logs, caches, exports and backups SHALL obey the same authority and
  disposal boundaries; no default contact-directory snapshot or protected payload copy.

requirement_contracts.title: Clear accessible interface
requirement_contracts.text:
Use shared Core UI, explicit actions, clear
  selection scope, understandable disposition/eligibility/history and truthful
  pending/partial/conflict/recovery feedback. The real browser SHALL meet the
  concrete keyboard, screen-reader, reflow and low-bandwidth cases above.

requirement_contracts.title: Native bounded operation
requirement_contracts.text:
Planning SHALL work without Studio, external
  campaign providers, a new group/list engine or a task/reminder per entry. Consumers
  SHALL use exact qualified source identities and outcome contracts.

requirement_contracts.title: Measurement and operations
requirement_contracts.text:
Scoped lists/history, permission-safe counts,
  group execution, query plans, lock waits and reconciliation SHALL be measured
  against an explicit numeric admitted workload and named budgets before release.
  No undocumented silent caps or unmeasured capacity claim is permitted.

requirement_contracts.title: Safe upgrade and restore
requirement_contracts.text:
Additive schema, compatible writers/readers,
  current source fences and data census SHALL precede activation. Imports/backfills
  SHALL not invent planning intent or outreach; disabling a consumer SHALL not
  waive restrictions. Rollback/restore SHALL preserve new accepted history and
  re-prove current exclusion/identity/access/disposal before affected work resumes.

Contribution helper guesses finance_operations and performs task/link/event writes in successive calls. Reuse qualified shared contract, not this helper as proof of atomic source work or eligible routing.

monitors.signal: Unselected inclusion, duplicate current member or stale retry restoring removed/excluded work
monitors.response: Stop affected new membership writer/group path, preserve receipts/history, investigate exact ordering, repair through source commands and require regression proof.

monitors.signal: Protected membership/count/reason/result exposed across current scope
monitors.response: Contain affected projection/export, investigate disclosure, repair cache/authorization and follow existing incident process.

acceptance_source_text.AC27-P01-01: **Given** a Party and eligible ministry with no participant, Support Binding, gift, email address or public Page, **when** authorized staff deliberately start ordinary work, **then** the identified relationship can be recorded without inventing any missing financial, public or participation fact.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P01-02: **Given** one enrollment for a ministry with successive asks and annual renewal, **when** the year, responsible worker, ministry display name or stage list changes, **then** the ordinary enrollment identity and earlier work remain; no new enrollment or fresh supporter assent is inferred.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P01-03: **Given** a worker participates in two ministries and a church has a named committee contact, **when** staff select a support relationship, **then** the actual Party and exact ministry are distinguishable; neither the worker login nor church contact silently substitutes for the selected subject.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P01-04: **Given** a relationship is not yet attributable to an identified ministry, **when** staff record an introduction or authorized task, **then** the useful Party/referral/task record is accepted through its owner without creating a cultivation enrollment or dummy ministry.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P01-05: **Given** two Tenants or two Legal Entities have similarly named ministries, **when** a command supplies a mismatched or hidden reference, **then** the command produces no cross-scope relationship or restricted identifying result; legitimate explicitly authorized multi-entity work uses each exact admitted scope.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P03-01: **Given** known authorized Party/ministry/purpose/work context exists, **when** staff expressly start cultivation while recording the included referral or ask, **then** one understandable action accepts the specifically included source effects without asking for known information again.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P03-02: **Given** a gift, score change, imported contact or introduction-only note arrives, **when** the source fact is processed, **then** no new enrollment is admitted; separately qualified financial/service facts and existing Party/task work remain usable.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P03-03: **Given** an ordinary enrollment already contains stages, owner and several open asks, **when** a new start operation resolves to permitted reuse, **then** those existing facts remain unchanged and only separately requested authorized work is added.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P03-04: **Given** paired fixtures differ only in whether a forbidden ordinary enrollment exists, **when** a caller lacking minimum admission-result authority attempts entry, **then** observable availability, bounded response, counts and errors do not expose the hidden difference or admit a workaround duplicate.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P03-05: **Given** a caller has limited reuse metadata authority but not history/edit authority, **when** the command resolves existing work, **then** only that admitted metadata is returned and no edit, history, missionary or finance access is created.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P02-01: **Given** an ordinary relationship includes prayer and monthly financial support, **when** an equipment ask is declined while an annual increase remains pending, **then** the same ordinary enrollment retains the independent responses, commitments and nonfinancial relationship without an automatic closure or stage change.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P05-01: **Given** a partnership has one established currently eligible lead, **when** staff start or review responsibility, **then** that lead is visibly prefilled and changeable without a separate confirmation; the unrelated creator/Party representative is not substituted.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P05-02: **Given** the partnership lead is unknown or several candidates are equally plausible, **when** staff start work, **then** the UI requests an authorized choice and does not use first result, administrator status or ministry membership as proof.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P05-05: **Given** a user becomes responsible for partnership or task work, **when** the source assignment is accepted, **then** no independent read, financial, consent, publication or missionary grant is created.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P07-01: **Given** appropriate authorized existing work already addresses the enrollment need, **when** staff start or continue cultivation, **then** the existing source task can satisfy next action and no duplicate task is created merely for enrollment.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P13-01: **Given** valid old rows are paired with hostile proposed Tenant, entity, Party, ministry, owner, actor or purpose fields, **when** each admitted insert/update/upsert/delete/returning/RPC/service/import/repair path is exercised under real effective roles, **then** all independently forbidden resulting states and spoofed attribution fail without leaking hidden constraint/source details.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P13-02: **Given** source links are null, partially-null composite references, cross-Tenant or mismatched entity references, **when** the command and applicable database constraints are exercised, **then** required identity cannot be fabricated and optional references are wholly absent or valid against their owners.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P13-03: **Given** member-without-grant, revoked-member, former-member-with-independent-grant and admitted service contexts exist, **when** read/action/result commands are evaluated, **then** current exact authority determines outcomes; role labels, enrollment and membership neither add nor remove independent valid grants by inference.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P13-04: **Given** faults occur at every local acceptance/history/receipt/work/intent boundary, **when** the command executes, **then** pre-commit failure leaves no partially accepted business change; post-commit secondary failure retains one source receipt and visible repairable pending/failed state.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P13-05: **Given** same intent is submitted through multiple transports or after a lost response, **when** duplicates, changed payload and stale out-of-order events arrive, **then** one intended effect remains; changed meaning conflicts and old events/receipts do not overwrite newer state or acquire new disclosure authority.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P13-06: **Given** permission revocation and acceptance contend in independent transactions, **when** each valid ordering is forced, **then** stale authority cannot create a new effect after the revocation boundary; accepted earlier history stays true without preserving future forbidden access.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P13-07: **Given** hidden source facts differ in paired fixtures while permitted inputs are identical, **when** counts, ranking, filters, selection, cached responses, errors and exports are observed, **then** unauthorized facts do not alter observable permitted output; stale responses after Tenant/role change are rejected.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P13-08: **Given** sensitive source material is redacted, expires or is lawfully erased, **when** history, task previews, notifications, reports, logs, exports, generated files and retained derivatives are reconciled, **then** admitted structural evidence remains only where permitted and protected bodies/identities are not restored or copied to evade source restrictions.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P13-09: **Given** an external owner returns an ambiguous timeout after possible success, **when** recovery runs, **then** the source/provider receipt is reconciled before retry and no blind duplicate effect or false success is reported.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P30-02: **Given** the same context uses long Thai, Arabic, Latin, combining-character names, RTL and restricted aliases, **when** the flow is rendered in supported locales and mobile widths, **then** full safe context is understandable without Western splitting, US-address assumptions, clipped critical labels or legal-name/location fallback.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P30-03: **Given** the flow contains dragging, dialogs, removed rows, validation and status changes, **when** keyboard-only, screen-reader and single-pointer users complete it, **then** actions have working alternatives, focus is visible/returned correctly, errors are associated and status changes are announced.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P30-04: **Given** the user operates at 320 CSS pixels, 400% zoom, light/dark modes and mobile keyboard conditions, **when** each ordinary action is completed, **then** meaning, required controls and safe source links remain usable with measured contrast and target compliance.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P30-05: **Given** a save response is delayed, dropped or rejected after permitted input is entered, **when** the user navigates, retries or returns, **then** the UI preserves allowed drafts and recovers the same intent while distinguishing accepted, pending, rejected and unconfirmed outcomes.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P30-06: **Given** current permissions or active Tenant change while old requests are pending, **when** late responses arrive, **then** denied draft content is removed and old-context responses cannot overwrite the current context or claim a forbidden success.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P30-07: **Given** a confirmed source mutation removes a row from the current list, **when** the result appears, **then** focus moves predictably, the durable result and next action remain understandable beyond a toast, and no unsafe generic Undo erases accepted or reused work.

requirement_contracts.title: Scope
requirement_contracts.text:
P27 SHALL provide one request/response capability for monetary,
narrow noncash-intention and significant nonfinancial partnership requests. It
SHALL reuse the existing partnership and distinguish routine shared tasks. The
four examples SHALL NOT be the exclusive permissible purposes.
Contextual recording SHALL NOT automatically enroll a Party or require an active
journey merely to preserve an otherwise-permitted historical fact. Qualify source
linking and any actual new admission under D4; do not invent a context-free request
inbox or duplicate existing P25/Support intake.

requirement_contracts.title: Relevant monetary facts
requirement_contracts.text:
A current monetary request SHALL carry valid
explicit entity/currency and the meaning of each applicable amount; recurring or
multi-year terms SHALL retain cadence, term and reporting horizon where relevant.
Unknown requested/expected values SHALL remain unknown, never zero defaults.
Nonfinancial current terms SHALL have no monetary fields or financial total
contribution. Financial rows SHALL use exact currency-aware minor units with
defined range/scale handling, no floating point or implicit FX. Narrow noncash
intentions SHALL NOT require or invent a monetary valuation or received-gift fact.

requirement_contracts.title: Atomic source mutation and replay
requirement_contracts.text:
Accept the intended source change,
required lawful history, durable business result and required effect intent
atomically. Check current authority and expected source/terms revisions. Durable
replay SHALL be bound to tenant/source/business purpose and normalized semantic
payload; changed terms with the same identity conflict. A retry of a formerly
successful action SHALL NOT reapply it over newer state. Distinguish current
authorization to disclose a result from the original accepted effect.

requirement_contracts.title: Tenant and actor safety
requirement_contracts.text:
Derive tenant, actor, recorder, authority and
audit attribution from trusted server context. Caller-selected assignees,
subjects, lists, financial references and source links require current eligibility
proof. Parent and child relationships SHALL be tenant/source aware independently
of nullable financial references. Disallow generic patches that can transform a
permitted row into a foreign, differently owned or historically rewritten state.

requirement_contracts.title: All database paths
requirement_contracts.text:
Before release, prove least-privilege grants and
RLS for all exposed tables; old-row and new-row mutation authorization, necessary
SELECT visibility, projection-safe views/functions/RPCs/storage, and equivalent
checks on privileged workers/imports. A function with elevated privileges requires
narrow grants, a fixed safe search path and explicit authority checks. Direct
history UPDATE/DELETE and cascading deletion of retained business facts SHALL be
denied except through qualified retention/correction procedures. Ordinary staff
commands SHALL NOT accept actor/tenant/approval metadata as authority.

requirement_contracts.title: Minimized disclosure
requirement_contracts.text:
Apply P12 field/purpose/existence rules to request
content, contacts, history, attachments, source links, search, caches, summaries,
counts, exports, logs and notifications. Staff, missionary and public surfaces
SHALL consume separately authorized projections. Prayer/visit records SHALL NOT
become care case notes, location dossiers or permission grants. Retention,
redaction/anonymization and backups follow governing owners; lawful history does
not mean indefinite unredacted retention. No new private-file store.

requirement_contracts.title: Clear accessible UX
requirement_contracts.text:
Use the shared Asym design system and record/task
patterns. Show current context, responsible person, actual request/response,
relevant financial details and next action. Provide deliberate Save, edit/record
response/close actions with truthful pending, success, denied and conflict states.
No default financial zero, required irrelevant field, drag-only action, fictional
stage progression, unannounced content change or compulsory narrative for an
ordinary permitted save. Mobile, keyboard, focus, locale and low-bandwidth recovery
are acceptance requirements, not optional polish.

requirement_contracts.title: Recoverable secondary effects
requirement_contracts.text:
Preserve one permanent source-purpose
identity across native and optional configurable follow-up. After source commit,
delivery/materialization failures SHALL be visible and retryable without another
business effect. An ambiguous external success SHALL reconcile with the owner
before replay. Cancellation stops remaining intent, not a committed historical
effect; no source-success rollback is fabricated when a response is lost.

requirement_contracts.title: Safe adoption and traceability
requirement_contracts.text:
Census actual legacy/custom/demo/import
data before migration; never reinterpret a zero-value gift/task as nonfinancial
request or create historical acceptance from inferred data. Expand compatible
readers/constraints before enabling writers, qualify old/new combinations, and
quarantine ambiguous imports for accountable resolution. After new writes,
rollback SHALL preserve lawful request/history/effect identities and prohibit old
writers that cannot express them. Trace D22 clauses and acceptance evidence into
the glossary/PRD/OpenSpec/design/tasks/tickets/release record through their
canonical authoring sources when those workflows are invoked.

requirement_contracts.title: Single intake owner
requirement_contracts.text:
P15 SHALL own the reported-handoff occurrence,
  evidence, lifecycle and exact intake lineage; P27 SHALL consume qualified source
  projections/actions. No separate appeal gift/custody writer SHALL be created.

requirement_contracts.title: Explicit receipt evidence
requirement_contracts.text:
The source SHALL distinguish trusted recorder,
  reported receipt/handling and time, and next accountable responsibility. Drafts,
  promises, assignments and dating fields SHALL NOT imply current physical custody.

requirement_contracts.title: Honest incomplete intake
requirement_contracts.text:
Unknown donor, intended entity, amount or
  allocation SHALL have a bounded source-owned exception path without invented
  values, weakened financial-root constraints or a P27 shadow record.

requirement_contracts.title: Separate authority
requirement_contracts.text:
Reporting, viewing, routing, financial entry/posting,
  correction, receipts and fulfillment SHALL use their own current qualified actions.
  Possession, assignment, role labels and appeal membership SHALL grant none.

requirement_contracts.title: Scoped identity and evidence
requirement_contracts.text:
Required source keys/FKs, actor attribution,
  legal-entity-bearing relationships and allowed resulting states SHALL be enforced
  across commands, grants/RLS, views/functions, imports and privileged paths.

requirement_contracts.title: Same-item continuation
requirement_contracts.text:
Reporters and finance SHALL continue the same
  source intake. Exact lineage SHALL survive moves/carry-forward; duplicate reports
  and existing recorded gifts SHALL reconcile without duplicate contributions.

requirement_contracts.title: Exact resolution
requirement_contracts.text:
Only qualified source evidence for the exact covered
  occurrence SHALL resolve recording. Amount/date/donor/check-number similarity,
  a generic status, task completion or incomplete coverage SHALL NOT suffice.

requirement_contracts.title: Independent dimensions
requirement_contracts.text:
Recording, physical handling/deposit, clearance,
  appeal membership, requests, commitment and fulfillment SHALL remain distinct.
  Posting SHALL NOT close independently required handling; transfer SHALL NOT post.

requirement_contracts.title: Truthful exceptions/history
requirement_contracts.text:
Loss, return, rejection, dispute, mistake and
  duplicate dispositions SHALL retain lawful evidence and exact remaining work.
  Source archive/appeal closure/member removal SHALL NOT discard unresolved handling.

requirement_contracts.title: Eligible native work
requirement_contracts.text:
Actual next work SHALL reuse qualified source Tasks
  Hub/attention identity, current eligible routing and source-controlled closure.
  No duplicate appeal queue, guessed fallback or automatic donor contact is permitted.

requirement_contracts.title: Atomic local effects
requirement_contracts.text:
Accepted source changes, required evidence/work
  disposition and operation receipts/intents SHALL commit coherently. Projection
  failure SHALL NOT falsify acceptance; independent posted money SHALL survive
  consumer failure and SHALL NOT be reposted to repair the consumer.

requirement_contracts.title: Concurrency and retry
requirement_contracts.text:
Material source heads and owner fences SHALL order
  competing changes. Same-intent retry SHALL preserve one effect and historical
  results; changed intent SHALL conflict and stale replay SHALL NOT overwrite later
  disposition. Incidental notes, display or assignment edits SHALL NOT erase
  accepted financial lineage or restart recording by themselves. Current result
  disclosure SHALL be independently reauthorized.

requirement_contracts.title: Honest money
requirement_contracts.text:
Pending reports SHALL NOT enter recorded-funding, settlement,
  public-progress or fulfillment totals. Qualified displayed amounts SHALL retain
  entity, currency, unit and meaning; unknown/noncash SHALL NOT become cash value.

requirement_contracts.title: Minimal protected data
requirement_contracts.text:
Report facts, references, counts, tasks, logs,
  exports, caches and history SHALL obey current field/purpose floors and retention.
  D25 SHALL introduce no check images, raw bank/card fields, OCR or file-store bypass.

requirement_contracts.title: Clear accessible flow
requirement_contracts.text:
The shared interface SHALL show known facts,
  uncertainty, next responsibility and permitted actions without duplicate entry,
  mandatory extra approval, exclusive supporter-status distortion or blind retry.
  The actual browser SHALL pass the concrete accessibility/recovery cases below.

requirement_contracts.title: Applicable bounded capability
requirement_contracts.text:
Online gifts and ordinary appeal members
  SHALL acquire no mandatory handoff stage. Noncash/other tender use SHALL require
  its owner qualification; no new inventory, shipping, valuation or policy engine.

requirement_contracts.title: Safe rollout and restore
requirement_contracts.text:
Reconcile the narrow P15 extension and qualify
  source scope/routing/lineage before activation. Migration, mixed writers and
  rollback SHALL preserve accepted evidence and current restrictions; restore SHALL
  reconcile current source truth before affected readers/workers resume.

requirement_contracts.title: Measured operations
requirement_contracts.text:
Numeric admitted workloads, query/command/recovery
  budgets, retry ceilings and named operating owners SHALL be established from
  measured source-shaped tests before release; no silent truncation or scale claim.

requirement_contracts.title: Traceable proof
requirement_contracts.text:
D25's glossary, owner extension, R/AC outcomes, future
  formal requirements/design/tasks and real release evidence SHALL agree. Synthetic
  resolution mechanics SHALL NOT be promoted to financial, RLS, custody or UI proof.

acceptance_source_text.AC27-P08-01: **Given** authorized staff choose a date and pause current work, **when** the same save is repeated, **then** one current review occurrence and at most one source task identity are retained; changed meaning under the same key conflicts.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P08-03: **Given** staff need a different date without conducting the review, **when** they reschedule the current occurrence, **then** the schedule changes with attributable history and no completed-review fact is created.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P08-06: **Given** staff intend meaningful future work but do not choose a date, **when** they attempt the dated-pause action, **then** a clear date requirement is shown without fabricating a cadence, donor action or completed review.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P09-01: **Given** the Tenant has a valid authoritative work timezone and today is selected, **when** staff save a pause, **then** the visible chosen date/zone and stored due interpretation agree and today is accepted.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P09-02: **Given** a new ordinary review date is in the past or the selected local date does not exist, **when** staff save, **then** a linked understandable error retains permitted input and no substitute date or review is accepted.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P09-03: **Given** the organization zone is missing or invalid, **when** staff choose a review date, **then** the flow requires the qualified setup/repair path and never silently uses browser timezone.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P09-04: **Given** a review spans a twenty-three-hour or twenty-five-hour day or crosses hemispheres, **when** due and overdue views are evaluated, **then** due begins at the first valid instant of the saved local date and overdue at the following local date, without UTC-midnight or one-hour drift.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P09-05: **Given** staff travel, the assignee changes or the Tenant changes its work timezone after acceptance, **when** the review is viewed and processed, **then** its saved date/zone meaning remains unchanged unless a deliberate qualified schedule correction occurs.

Changing an unsent list visibly resolves its incompatible stage without mapping equal labels/ranks, clears no saved work and preserves unrelated input. Server validates concrete final list/stage-or-absence; missing list never means use latest default. Keep no-current-assessment, known/retired value, hidden field, loading, failed/partial/legacy-unknown distinct through source reads, UI, pagination and export. Basic current population retains unassessed work. Same ordinary work with another/withdrawn retained list is reused without rebinding or clearing. operating_monitors.signal: Valid no-stage admission blocked or silently defaulted
operating_monitors.threshold: Any confirmed reproduction on a supported path
operating_monitors.response: Fix or disable the affected path while preserving accepted work; add all-path regression evidence.

operating_monitors.signal: Eligible unassessed work missing from an ordinary view/declared total
operating_monitors.threshold: Any confirmed mismatch for identical authorized scope/coverage
operating_monitors.owner: P27 read-model owner; P33 for metric semantics
operating_monitors.response: Correct source-derived query/projection, reconcile affected views, preserve provenance; do not relabel records to hide the error.

operating_monitors.signal: Cross-scope/field existence disclosure through absence/read/count
operating_monitors.response: Contain affected exposure immediately, preserve minimal incident evidence, require negative authorization proof before reactivation.

operating_monitors.signal: Old null intent overwrites a recorded stage or duplicates its effect
operating_monitors.response: Stop affected writer/replay path, reconcile from durable evidence through qualified repair, restore only after race/retry tests.

operating_monitors.signal: Admission/assessment remains unconfirmed after attempted reconciliation
operating_monitors.threshold: One completed reconciliation attempt still cannot determine the authoritative result
operating_monitors.response: Keep outcome explicitly unresolved, inspect durable intent/result and source revision; do not issue a new effect blindly.

operating_monitors.signal: Critical user cannot identify outcome, next action or Set/Change stage
operating_monitors.threshold: Any reproducible critical task failure in pilot/support
operating_monitors.response: Fix/test the interaction; block expansion of affected flow, preserve a qualified accessible alternative.

operating_monitors.signal: Query breaches its approved measured release budget
operating_monitors.threshold: Three consecutive measurements within 15 minutes for the same declared workload slice
operating_monitors.response: Inspect plan/load/coverage, reduce affected rollout or repair query/index; do not drop unassessed/unauthorized distinctions for speed.

operating_monitors.signal: Accepted wrong-list stage, silent stage substitution or duplicate ordinary work caused by list choice
operating_monitors.response: Contain the affected admission door, preserve receipts/history, identify affected work and correct through the qualified source boundary.

operating_monitors.signal: Unauthorized catalog/context/preview/count/result disclosure
operating_monitors.response: Contain affected cache/API/export access and follow existing incident procedure; verify current-context isolation before reopening.

operating_monitors.signal: Valid choice denied solely by an unselected app/Party-type/process filter
operating_monitors.response: Remove the unselected restriction while preserving real source/permission floors; test affected surfaces and regression.

operating_monitors.signal: Accepted result missing required binding/history/receipt or late UI result applied to another context
operating_monitors.response: Stop the faulty mutation/presentation path as appropriate, reconcile source evidence and repair without replaying accepted effects.

operating_monitors.signal: Staff misunderstand a list as changing giving/access or creating another partnership
operating_monitors.threshold: Any validated support report or observed usability failure
operating_monitors.response: Reproduce, correct wording/interaction/guidance and retest; investigate erroneous records through the qualified correction path.

AC27-P33-02: **Given** a relevant human inbound arrives without a stored prior outbound and may be a brief decline, **when** its source outcome is qualified, **then** it can count as an exchange without message pairing, length, sentiment or financial threshold; automated or uncertain reply evidence alone cannot count.

AC27-P33-03: **Given** call attempts, voicemail, booked/cancelled/no-show meetings, passive attendance and an actual manually recorded conversation exist, **when** exchange recency is computed, **then** only actual qualified exchange evidence contributes; calendar/task completion alone creates none.

AC27-P33-04: **Given** two narratives or repeated transport/import/share/edit refer to one underlying meeting, **when** staff and missionary permitted views display it, **then** one actual encounter remains with distinct attributed contributions and no duplicated logging step or event count.

AC27-P33-05: **Given** history includes backdated, date-only, unknown-date, future-plan and invalid future-completed values across timezone travel, **when** source dates and recency are displayed, **then** actual precision is retained; unknown never becomes save time/epoch or reliable aging and future planned/untrue completion does not become actual exchange.

AC27-P33-06: **Given** the latest qualifying exchange lies outside the first fifty display rows, **when** the latest source fact is found then corrected/restricted/merged, **then** source-complete recency finds it and subsequently derives an earlier or unknown truthful result rather than a stale permanent maximum.

AC27-P33-07: **Given** a user supplies another Tenant, church-affiliation-only link, different ministry purpose or merely selected participant, **when** a contribution or projection is requested, **then** no other partnership is updated and protected date/type/source/count information is not disclosed.

AC27-P33-08: **Given** a source body expires or source authority is revoked, **when** recency, summaries, source links and exports are requested, **then** only separately qualified permitted body-free facts remain; copied bodies or church access cannot bypass source restrictions.

AC27-P33-09: **Given** a missionary chooses not to log or an actual reply arrives during paused/closed work, **when** the ordinary workspace and relationship are evaluated, **then** normal use remains available without penalty, score or invented task; lifecycle and actual consent/obligations remain unchanged.

AC27-P33-10: **Given** the user encounters empty, filtered, incomplete, undated, loading or unavailable history, **when** the compact relationship context is displayed, **then** each admitted state is understandable without Never contacted claims or revealing private event existence.

AC27-P33-11: **Given** a contribution save is slow, loses its response or races a scope change, **when** the user recovers it, **then** permitted draft context and one accepted source intent remain, with no silent offline publication, duplicate encounter or false success.

AC27-P33-12: **Given** keyboard/screen-reader/touch/mobile/RTL/long-name/low-bandwidth users complete the flow, **when** they record, explain and correct an exchange, **then** instructions, source links, focus, contrast, reflow, dates and status remain usable without address forms, transcripts, duplicate logs or meaningfulness checkboxes.

AC27-P33-13: **Given** representative staff and missionaries inspect sent outreach, real exchange, unknown coverage and agreed follow-up examples, **when** they interpret the UI without coaching, **then** they distinguish all four meanings; any unsafe confusion blocks rollout expansion until corrected and retested.

AC27-P33-14: **Given** donor checkout, donor account or public content is used, **when** internal exchange recency changes or becomes old, **then** those surfaces gain no field/step/internal disclosure and no new contact is triggered merely by age or missing reply.

requirement_contracts.title: Scope
requirement_contracts.text:
P27 SHALL provide one request/response capability for monetary,
narrow noncash-intention and significant nonfinancial partnership requests. It
SHALL reuse the existing partnership and distinguish routine shared tasks. The
four examples SHALL NOT be the exclusive permissible purposes.
Contextual recording SHALL NOT automatically enroll a Party or require an active
journey merely to preserve an otherwise-permitted historical fact. Qualify source
linking and any actual new admission under D4; do not invent a context-free request
inbox or duplicate existing P25/Support intake.

requirement_contracts.title: Relevant monetary facts
requirement_contracts.text:
A current monetary request SHALL carry valid
explicit entity/currency and the meaning of each applicable amount; recurring or
multi-year terms SHALL retain cadence, term and reporting horizon where relevant.
Unknown requested/expected values SHALL remain unknown, never zero defaults.
Nonfinancial current terms SHALL have no monetary fields or financial total
contribution. Financial rows SHALL use exact currency-aware minor units with
defined range/scale handling, no floating point or implicit FX. Narrow noncash
intentions SHALL NOT require or invent a monetary valuation or received-gift fact.

requirement_contracts.title: Owner boundaries
requirement_contracts.text:
Positive response SHALL NOT create a pledge, recurring
agreement, charge, gift, consent, subscription, referral edge, appointment, booking
or application. Any deliberate handoff SHALL use the qualified owning command,
current authority, explicit scope and durable result identity. Unavailable owner
capability SHALL leave a visible actionable state, never a local shadow substitute.
Required native internal follow-through SHALL work without Phase 34 or 42.

requirement_contracts.title: Tenant and actor safety
requirement_contracts.text:
Derive tenant, actor, recorder, authority and
audit attribution from trusted server context. Caller-selected assignees,
subjects, lists, financial references and source links require current eligibility
proof. Parent and child relationships SHALL be tenant/source aware independently
of nullable financial references. Disallow generic patches that can transform a
permitted row into a foreign, differently owned or historically rewritten state.

requirement_contracts.title: All database paths
requirement_contracts.text:
Before release, prove least-privilege grants and
RLS for all exposed tables; old-row and new-row mutation authorization, necessary
SELECT visibility, projection-safe views/functions/RPCs/storage, and equivalent
checks on privileged workers/imports. A function with elevated privileges requires
narrow grants, a fixed safe search path and explicit authority checks. Direct
history UPDATE/DELETE and cascading deletion of retained business facts SHALL be
denied except through qualified retention/correction procedures. Ordinary staff
commands SHALL NOT accept actor/tenant/approval metadata as authority.

requirement_contracts.title: Clear accessible UX
requirement_contracts.text:
Use the shared Asym design system and record/task
patterns. Show current context, responsible person, actual request/response,
relevant financial details and next action. Provide deliberate Save, edit/record
response/close actions with truthful pending, success, denied and conflict states.
No default financial zero, required irrelevant field, drag-only action, fictional
stage progression, unannounced content change or compulsory narrative for an
ordinary permitted save. Mobile, keyboard, focus, locale and low-bandwidth recovery
are acceptance requirements, not optional polish.

requirement_contracts.title: Lossless conditional editing
requirement_contracts.text:
Changing applicable details SHALL NOT
silently discard entered work or submit hidden stale amounts. Current saved terms
and historical presented terms remain distinguishable. Omitted fields, explicit
absence, unknown, not applicable and denied/unloaded values SHALL NOT be collapsed
by forms, schemas, imports or projections. On unsafe stale state, preserve only
the draft content the current actor may still access and provide a clear recovery.

requirement_contracts.title: Financial reporting
requirement_contracts.text:
Report requested, forecast, response, source
commitment and source received/adjusted outcomes separately with coverage and
as-of meaning. Nonfinancial requests SHALL NOT lower monetary averages or inflate
funding totals; optional amount queries SHALL NOT make them vanish from ordinary
request counts. Do not add mutually exclusive proposals, recognition and gifts,
different currencies/entities, or repeated source coverage into an unlabeled
total. Any allocation/fulfillment claim requires the owning contract, not a
date/amount/Party match or copied financial status.

requirement_contracts.title: Bounded policy
Authority separation
requirement_contracts.text:
Preparation, submission, requirement administration,
  exception, decision, reassignment, correction and presentation SHALL resolve current
  exact P12 powers independently. Assignment and role labels SHALL grant none of them.

requirement_contracts.title: Reviewer eligibility
requirement_contracts.text:
Required review SHALL have one current qualified
  internal reviewer or a visible source-owned recovery condition. Allowed self-review
  SHALL be deliberate; actual separation floors SHALL use stable person identity.

requirement_contracts.title: Current applicability
requirement_contracts.text:
Future supported actions SHALL use current required
  review coverage and source authority. Policy changes SHALL preserve explicit choices
  and historical facts, and SHALL never automatically send. Unrelated routing changes
  or reviewer departure alone SHALL NOT invalidate an accepted decision.

requirement_contracts.title: Database invariants
requirement_contracts.text:
Complete scoped relationships, finite valid values,
  one pending target and one terminal decision per round SHALL be enforced by database
  constraints and one authoritative command boundary, including privileged paths.

requirement_contracts.title: Clear accessible UI
requirement_contracts.text:
The shared interface SHALL show meaningful current
  state, exact review scope, responsible next actor, permitted next action and change
  path; preserve relevant input, announce outcomes and distinguish failed/unknown/
  restricted states. It SHALL satisfy the concrete UX/browser cases above.

requirement_contracts.title: Independent native operation
requirement_contracts.text:
The complete native flow SHALL work without
  Studio, external approval vendors, a second inbox, a rule builder or an invented
  timer. Optional orchestration SHALL consume the same source fact and effect identity.

requirement_contracts.title: Safe rollout
requirement_contracts.text:
Capability/schema/reader/worker/owner-binding compatibility
  SHALL precede activation; old clients/imports SHALL not create approvals. A kill
  switch SHALL stop unsafe new decisions/actions without converting required review
  to optional or destroying truthful history.

requirement_contracts.title: Single intake owner
requirement_contracts.text:
P15 SHALL own the reported-handoff occurrence,
  evidence, lifecycle and exact intake lineage; P27 SHALL consume qualified source
  projections/actions. No separate appeal gift/custody writer SHALL be created.

requirement_contracts.title: Explicit receipt evidence
requirement_contracts.text:
The source SHALL distinguish trusted recorder,
  reported receipt/handling and time, and next accountable responsibility. Drafts,
  promises, assignments and dating fields SHALL NOT imply current physical custody.

requirement_contracts.title: Honest incomplete intake
requirement_contracts.text:
Unknown donor, intended entity, amount or
  allocation SHALL have a bounded source-owned exception path without invented
  values, weakened financial-root constraints or a P27 shadow record.

requirement_contracts.title: Separate authority
requirement_contracts.text:
Reporting, viewing, routing, financial entry/posting,
  correction, receipts and fulfillment SHALL use their own current qualified actions.
  Possession, assignment, role labels and appeal membership SHALL grant none.

requirement_contracts.title: Scoped identity and evidence
requirement_contracts.text:
Required source keys/FKs, actor attribution,
  legal-entity-bearing relationships and allowed resulting states SHALL be enforced
  across commands, grants/RLS, views/functions, imports and privileged paths.

requirement_contracts.title: Same-item continuation
requirement_contracts.text:
Reporters and finance SHALL continue the same
  source intake. Exact lineage SHALL survive moves/carry-forward; duplicate reports
  and existing recorded gifts SHALL reconcile without duplicate contributions.

requirement_contracts.title: Exact resolution
requirement_contracts.text:
Only qualified source evidence for the exact covered
  occurrence SHALL resolve recording. Amount/date/donor/check-number similarity,
  a generic status, task completion or incomplete coverage SHALL NOT suffice.

requirement_contracts.title: Independent dimensions
requirement_contracts.text:
Recording, physical handling/deposit, clearance,
  appeal membership, requests, commitment and fulfillment SHALL remain distinct.
  Posting SHALL NOT close independently required handling; transfer SHALL NOT post.

requirement_contracts.title: Truthful exceptions/history
requirement_contracts.text:
Loss, return, rejection, dispute, mistake and
  duplicate dispositions SHALL retain lawful evidence and exact remaining work.
  Source archive/appeal closure/member removal SHALL NOT discard unresolved handling.

requirement_contracts.title: Atomic local effects
requirement_contracts.text:
Accepted source changes, required evidence/work
  disposition and operation receipts/intents SHALL commit coherently. Projection
  failure SHALL NOT falsify acceptance; independent posted money SHALL survive
  consumer failure and SHALL NOT be reposted to repair the consumer.

requirement_contracts.title: Concurrency and retry
requirement_contracts.text:
Material source heads and owner fences SHALL order
  competing changes. Same-intent retry SHALL preserve one effect and historical
  results; changed intent SHALL conflict and stale replay SHALL NOT overwrite later
  disposition. Incidental notes, display or assignment edits SHALL NOT erase
  accepted financial lineage or restart recording by themselves. Current result
  disclosure SHALL be independently reauthorized.

requirement_contracts.title: Honest money
requirement_contracts.text:
Pending reports SHALL NOT enter recorded-funding, settlement,
  public-progress or fulfillment totals. Qualified displayed amounts SHALL retain
  entity, currency, unit and meaning; unknown/noncash SHALL NOT become cash value.

requirement_contracts.title: Clear accessible flow
requirement_contracts.text:
The shared interface SHALL show known facts,
  uncertainty, next responsibility and permitted actions without duplicate entry,
  mandatory extra approval, exclusive supporter-status distortion or blind retry.
  The actual browser SHALL pass the concrete accessibility/recovery cases below.

requirement_contracts.title: Safe rollout and restore
requirement_contracts.text:
Reconcile the narrow P15 extension and qualify
  source scope/routing/lineage before activation. Migration, mixed writers and
  rollback SHALL preserve accepted evidence and current restrictions; restore SHALL
  reconcile current source truth before affected readers/workers resume.

acceptance_source_text.AC27-P10-03: **Given** an enabled staff or missionary recipient profile is used, **when** the user opens the task and attention, **then** each route resolves the same source review and allowed action with a working role-safe authenticated link; incomplete or reserved profiles cannot emit substitute attention.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P10-04: **Given** a user reads an actionable review notification, **when** they revisit work or try to archive it, **then** the unresolved work remains actionable and archive is unavailable; after source ending it is visible only within the authorized 90-day Recent ceiling.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P10-07: **Given** a protected reason, restricted identity or worker location is associated with the source, **when** task previews, notification payloads, logs, counts, exports and links are examined under each admitted role, **then** only independently allowed minimal metadata appears; public and donor surfaces receive no review context.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P10-08: **Given** the optional email provider or Studio is unavailable, **when** a qualified internal-only review becomes due, **then** native source work and permitted in-product attention remain functional without a substitute email or duplicate Studio effect.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P32-06: **Given** backfill or a recipient/surface profile changes from Reserved to Live, **when** activation runs, **then** no historical attention is emitted; any eligible legacy-work reminder proves a distinct prospective qualified source transition.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P32-08: **Given** an eligible due review lacks required local attention, **when** the delay passes 15 minutes from the later eligible due/schedule-recipient boundary, **then** the recorded platform-operations signal fires without retry-resetting age, substitute email or marking review complete.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P32-09: **Given** a local materialization reaches typed terminal failure or a qualified responsibility resolver is zero/indeterminate, **when** operating recovery is evaluated, **then** the named owner receives an authorized source repair route and the original identity is reconciled without broadening access or routine SQL edits.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P10-01: **Given** the lead, creator, Party representative and finance owner are different people, **when** review responsibility and due attention resolve, **then** only the qualified current lead or authorized explicit review assignee receives the appropriate source-backed work; other identities receive nothing without independent qualification.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P10-02: **Given** a currently eligible explicit review assignee exists, **when** the partnership lead changes, **then** the explicit review responsibility remains until a deliberate qualified handoff changes it; no duplicate recipient is inferred.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P10-05: **Given** zero eligible recipients, an indeterminate resolver or revocation immediately before release occurs, **when** the worker processes the review, **then** no unqualified recipient receives attention and an authorized source repair exception remains; restored access does not revive an ended engagement.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P08-04: **Given** the due date arrives or a notification is read/archived or a gift is received, **when** the external or engagement event is processed, **then** cultivation remains paused, the review remains unresolved, and no automatic donor contact or source completion occurs.

operating_monitors.signal: Eligible current due review lacks its required local attention
operating_monitors.threshold: Age exceeds **15 minutes** after eligible due instant, excluding typed not-applicable cases
operating_monitors.response: Investigate source/dispatch/qualification, reconcile the same effect; disable new attention admission for broken profile if needed. Preserve source work; no substitute email. Threshold is a planning target, not measured performance.

operating_monitors.signal: Scope leak, unauthorized recipient or duplicate durable active effect
operating_monitors.owner: Security/on-call with P27 and P6/P17 owners
operating_monitors.response: Stop affected profile, preserve evidence, revoke protected presentation, repair source/contract and requalify before resumption. These remain zero-tolerance release tests.

operating_monitors.signal: Permanent projection failure or retry exhaustion
operating_monitors.threshold: **One** typed terminal failure under the platform's existing retry policy
operating_monitors.response: Surface error and recover/replay original source identity; do not mark review complete or ask staff to repair SQL.

operating_monitors.signal: Human review remains unfinished past chosen local date
operating_monitors.response: Keep it visible in the existing due/overdue work view; review or deliberately revise it. No new automatic escalation/cadence.

operating_monitors.signal: Staff cannot find/act on a review in the admitted surface, or can mistake it for donor contact
operating_monitors.threshold: **One** reproducible failure in the supported task flow
operating_monitors.response: Fix the flow/copy or suspend that recipient/surface profile; repeat the affected accessibility/usability acceptance before widening rollout.
