acceptance_source_text.AC27-P20-01:
**Given** The stated recorded stage, source obligations and approved stage definitions.
**When** an ordinary stage choice, skip, return, no-op or advisory-guidance interaction occurs.
**Then** every stated observable result and invariant below SHALL hold, with the specified fixtures and boundary cases included in verification:

Given valid current authority, eligible target and satisfied source obligations, save an ordinary stage change with no explanation, acknowledgment or tenant-required field. No new note/checklist/approval/task is demanded merely for the change. Unsafe optional content, if separately supplied, follows its own validation and may be removed.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P20-02:
**Given** The stated recorded stage, source obligations and approved stage definitions.
**When** an ordinary stage choice, skip, return, no-op or advisory-guidance interaction occurs.
**Then** every stated observable result and invariant below SHALL hold, with the specified fixtures and boundary cases included in verification:

An untouched missing newly required Party/custom field does not block the stage-only action and is absent from its payload. An actually requested governed field edit still receives its owner's validation. No filler, default or private data is added to bypass a form.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P20-04:
**Given** The stated recorded stage, source obligations and approved stage definitions.
**When** an ordinary stage choice, skip, return, no-op or advisory-guidance interaction occurs.
**Then** every stated observable result and invariant below SHALL hold, with the specified fixtures and boundary cases included in verification:

Starting at X, accept X→Z: exactly that change exists, with no Y visit. Then Z→X: both changes remain with distinct source revisions/occurrences. No new supporter, gift, consent, closure, contact or completed task is inferred.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P20-05:
**Given** The stated recorded stage, source obligations and approved stage definitions.
**When** an ordinary stage choice, skip, return, no-op or advisory-guidance interaction occurs.
**Then** every stated observable result and invariant below SHALL hold, with the specified fixtures and boundary cases included in verification:

A same-value save creates no new stage history, entry/assessment time or effect. Retry an earlier accepted mutation and an earlier no-op after intervening changes: each returns only its currently disclosable historical result and cannot mutate or overwrite the current value.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P20-06: **Given** an ordinary skip or return meets actual platform and source safeguards, **when** the user selects and saves the destination, **then** tenant guidance is advisory and the flow adds no rank-derived regression warning, completion styling, compulsory information or extra ceremony.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P23-03:
**Given** The stated real principals, role grants, source scopes and current policy states, including denied or revoked cases.
**When** the specified command, read, result, cache, export or recovery door is exercised.
**Then** every stated observable result and invariant below SHALL hold, with the specified fixtures and boundary cases included in verification:

Exercise real nonowner application roles and API/RPC paths: cross-tenant/entity/preset targets, broad extra payload fields, scope/actor spoofing, lead/configurator without stage power and service jobs. Reject forbidden old/new states and preserve history atomically; verify actual grants/RLS/function owners/search paths.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P23-04:
**Given** The stated real principals, role grants, source scopes and current policy states, including denied or revoked cases.
**When** the specified command, read, result, cache, export or recovery door is exercised.
**Then** every stated observable result and invariant below SHALL hold, with the specified fixtures and boundary cases included in verification:

Revoke authority during editing, deferred execution and result replay; enforce current source/purpose/field/history/residency policy. Hidden-present/absent targets, stale-editor identity and unique/FK errors reveal no unauthorized facts. Protected aliases remain protected.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P23-05:
**Given** The stated real principals, role grants, source scopes and current policy states, including denied or revoked cases.
**When** the specified command, read, result, cache, export or recovery door is exercised.
**Then** every stated observable result and invariant below SHALL hold, with the specified fixtures and boundary cases included in verification:

Test stale caches, tenant/context switches, redaction/retention, CSV/document output, denied history and backup restore. Expose only currently permitted content; older responses cannot overwrite newer accepted revisions. No sensitive guidance/narrative remains in an unauthorized draft or shared cache.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P23-06:
**Given** The stated real principals, role grants, source scopes and current policy states, including denied or revoked cases.
**When** the specified command, read, result, cache, export or recovery door is exercised.
**Then** every stated observable result and invariant below SHALL hold, with the specified fixtures and boundary cases included in verification:

Exercise actual authenticated, unauthenticated, limited missionary/staff, configuration-only, revoked and admitted service/operator paths. Cross-tenant/entity/preset, forged attribution and mutable-scope attempts fail; direct table/RPC/view routes cannot bypass the source. Prove effective USING/WITH CHECK and grants with real nonowner roles, plus privileged-path safety.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P23-07:
**Given** The stated real principals, role grants, source scopes and current policy states, including denied or revoked cases.
**When** the specified command, read, result, cache, export or recovery door is exercised.
**Then** every stated observable result and invariant below SHALL hold, with the specified fixtures and boundary cases included in verification:

Hidden/absent targets and forbidden history/receipt cases reveal only permitted observations. Revoke access while previewing/submitting/replaying/exporting and restore a backup: no stale cache, actor, protected label/note or restored authority leaks. Audit retains lawful minimal attribution separately from technical logs.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P24-08:
**Given** The specified valid and adversarial source states, revisions and durable intents.
**When** the actual mutation protocol runs through the stated races, retries or injected failures.
**Then** every stated observable result and invariant below SHALL hold, with the specified fixtures and boundary cases included in verification:

Interleave competing updates at one revision; at most one conflicting intent wins. Duplicate simultaneous deliveries of one intent yield one effect. Changed payload under that key fails. Inject failure after source writes but before source commit: current value, required history/result/effect intent roll back atomically.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P25-03:
**Given** The stated source facts, interface state, access context, device and connection conditions.
**When** the actual offered interaction, history read or recovery path is completed.
**Then** every stated observable result and invariant below SHALL hold, with the specified fixtures and boundary cases included in verification:

From an authorized partnership context, identify current stage, understand the proposed stage's meaning, choose and save through one compact interaction without leaving for settings. Browsing/help/cancel has no source effect; one deliberate commit is sufficient. Missing optional guidance is not a validation error.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P25-04:
**Given** The stated source facts, interface state, access context, device and connection conditions.
**When** the actual offered interaction, history read or recovery path is completed.
**Then** every stated observable result and invariant below SHALL hold, with the specified fixtures and boundary cases included in verification:

Disconnect/fail before commit, after commit before response and during downstream projection. UI distinguishes known rejection from unconfirmed outcome; recovery finds the authorized accepted result. Late errors cannot roll back newer data. Closing/canceling after submit never claims to undo a committed update.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P25-05:
**Given** The stated source facts, interface state, access context, device and connection conditions.
**When** the actual offered interaction, history read or recovery path is completed.
**Then** every stated observable result and invariant below SHALL hold, with the specified fixtures and boundary cases included in verification:

Long Unicode/RTL/translated labels and international names remain distinguishable under 200% text resizing and reflow at an effective 320 CSS px width (including a 1280 CSS px viewport at 400% browser zoom). Relevant controls stay reachable with soft keyboard and slow connection. Locale/timezone changes alter presentation, not identity or D6 date-only meaning.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P25-06:
**Given** The stated source facts, interface state, access context, device and connection conditions.
**When** the actual offered interaction, history read or recovery path is completed.
**Then** every stated observable result and invariant below SHALL hold, with the specified fixtures and boundary cases included in verification:

Complete normal, cancellation, failure and conflict flows using keyboard, screen reader and tap/click; verify names, described help/errors, focus and restoration, material status announcements, light/dark contrast, Core touch targets and reduced motion. Drag is optional; automated axe checks supplement manual outcomes.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P25-07:
**Given** The stated source facts, interface state, access context, device and connection conditions.
**When** the actual offered interaction, history read or recovery path is completed.
**Then** every stated observable result and invariant below SHALL hold, with the specified fixtures and boundary cases included in verification:

Lose the accepted response, close/reopen the editor, deliver old responses after newer changes and interrupt secondary refresh. UI distinguishes unconfirmed, historical accepted and current state; reconciliation reuses intent and never regresses the journey or another list row. A saved change that removes an item from the current filter remains understandable, with the known permitted reason, an authorized way to locate it and useful focus. Post-commit failure never undoes source acceptance.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P25-08:
**Given** The stated source facts, interface state, access context, device and connection conditions.
**When** the actual offered interaction, history read or recovery path is completed.
**Then** every stated observable result and invariant below SHALL hold, with the specified fixtures and boundary cases included in verification:

Through the actual browser, complete and cancel from every offered entry point with keyboard, screen reader, touch and a non-drag single-pointer path. Browsing/Escape before submission does not save. Focus, names, help, pending/error/conflict and success announcements are correct. No color/toast/hover-only essential information or edit affordance implying authority on a read-only journey.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P25-09:
**Given** The stated source facts, interface state, access context, device and connection conditions.
**When** the actual offered interaction, history read or recovery path is completed.
**Then** every stated observable result and invariant below SHALL hold, with the specified fixtures and boundary cases included in verification:

Current retired value, no choice, no matches, long/duplicate/localized labels, changed guidance and failed loading remain distinguishable. No accidental blank/default value or fabricated new stage. Participants identify current vs proposed vs saved and understand that moving back keeps history.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P25-10:
**Given** The stated source facts, interface state, access context, device and connection conditions.
**When** the actual offered interaction, history read or recovery path is completed.
**Then** every stated observable result and invariant below SHALL hold, with the specified fixtures and boundary cases included in verification:

Verify exact shared design-system composition, contrast, Core touch targets, text resize, reflow, RTL and mobile soft keyboard. On a declared low-bandwidth/high-latency/disconnection profile, no false saved state, duplicate effect or inaccessible recovery. Do not claim offline save support without separate qualification.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P26-02:
**Given** The stated stage/list operation and independently owned work, financial, communication and participation facts.
**When** acceptance, projection, optional integration or retry occurs.
**Then** every stated observable result and invariant below SHALL hold, with the specified fixtures and boundary cases included in verification:

A real stage change records actual actor/time/from/to provenance without requiring a narrative. It changes no contact/giving/consent/closure fact. Preserve valid existing work and expose genuine missing accountability; no duplicate task or false completion appears. Optional context is not copied into unrestricted logs. Where an existing qualified flow submits text with a stage, inject partial success/response loss: report each actual accepted outcome without discarding or duplicating text or certifying an unsaved note.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P26-03:
**Given** The stated stage/list operation and independently owned work, financial, communication and participation facts.
**When** acceptance, projection, optional integration or retry occurs.
**Then** every stated observable result and invariant below SHALL hold, with the specified fixtures and boundary cases included in verification:

Native updates work with Studio and unrelated providers unavailable. DON-14 cannot gate or reverse the accepted stage; duplicate/out-of-order downstream delivery preserves one source effect and current authority. Financial/prayer-like stage labels create no financial or participation evidence.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P26-04:
**Given** The stated stage/list operation and independently owned work, financial, communication and participation facts.
**When** acceptance, projection, optional integration or retry occurs.
**Then** every stated observable result and invariant below SHALL hold, with the specified fixtures and boundary cases included in verification:

Test the same authorized source meaning on staff and missionary projections, with native operation when optional Studio/providers are unavailable. Stage change does not resume/close work, alter assignments, waive contact suppression, certify participation or become a financial transaction. Initial stage/preset/correction/bulk capabilities are not smuggled in.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P26-05:
**Given** The stated stage/list operation and independently owned work, financial, communication and participation facts.
**When** acceptance, projection, optional integration or retry occurs.
**Then** every stated observable result and invariant below SHALL hold, with the specified fixtures and boundary cases included in verification:

Preserve applicable existing next work without duplicate chores; expose the owned actionable exception when appropriate. A repeat stage does not revive ended/consumed work. Deliver duplicate/out-of-order native/Studio events and ambiguous provider outcomes: current source applicability and one purpose identity control recovery.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P27-03:
**Given** The stated retained data, supported versions, real reached paths and declared release cohort/workload.
**When** migration, qualification, rollout, restore or representative user tasks are executed.

requirement_contracts.title: Independent decisions
requirement_contracts.text:
Separate requested decisions that need independent
responses SHALL have independently attributable outcomes. The minimum design is
separate request records on the same partnership, sharing qualified encounter
references where appropriate. A coherent invitation that can be understood and
answered together MAY remain one request without splitting all descriptive parts.
An installment, designation line, staff attribution
or reporting dimension alone SHALL NOT create another request. Partial agreement
SHALL NOT imply agreement to other requested decisions or conditions.

requirement_contracts.title: Presentation, revision and forecast history
requirement_contracts.text:
The system SHALL distinguish
draft preparation, actual presentation, current revised terms and earlier
presented terms. Response evidence SHALL identify the terms it addresses. Original
and revised requested terms and staff forecast versions SHALL remain lawfully
traceable; later outcome SHALL NOT rewrite the forecast that preceded it. A
correction and a genuinely new proposal SHALL be distinguishable.

A fresh, currently authorized recording MAY identify an older presented version
for a late response; current-revision checks prevent stale writes, not truthful
recording about historical terms.

requirement_contracts.title: Honest response
requirement_contracts.text:
Record the actual known response, speaker/capacity,
occurrence precision, recording time and trusted recorder. No answer, positive,
partial/conditional, declined and deferred meanings SHALL remain distinct;
withdrawal is not a supporter decline. Record already-made requests/responses
together without fictional intermediate transitions. Recording a fact SHALL NOT
claim that the action was authorized, compliant, delivered or legally binding.

requirement_contracts.title: Owner boundaries
requirement_contracts.text:
Positive response SHALL NOT create a pledge, recurring
agreement, charge, gift, consent, subscription, referral edge, appointment, booking
or application. Any deliberate handoff SHALL use the qualified owning command,
current authority, explicit scope and durable result identity. Unavailable owner
capability SHALL leave a visible actionable state, never a local shadow substitute.
Required native internal follow-through SHALL work without Phase 34 or 42.

requirement_contracts.title: Lifecycle independence
requirement_contracts.text:
Request edits/closure/response SHALL NOT silently
change partnership stage, pause/review/closure, Party lifecycle, other requests,
communication eligibility or independent obligations. Late evidence and corrections
SHALL preserve earlier facts and recording provenance. Genuine resumed partnership
work follows D8; ended child effects SHALL NOT revive automatically.

requirement_contracts.title: Atomic source mutation and replay
requirement_contracts.text:
Accept the intended source change,
required lawful history, durable business result and required effect intent
atomically. Check current authority and expected source/terms revisions. Durable
replay SHALL be bound to tenant/source/business purpose and normalized semantic
payload; changed terms with the same identity conflict. A retry of a formerly
successful action SHALL NOT reapply it over newer state. Distinguish current
authorization to disclose a result from the original accepted effect.

requirement_contracts.title: Minimized disclosure
requirement_contracts.text:
Apply P12 field/purpose/existence rules to request
content, contacts, history, attachments, source links, search, caches, summaries,
counts, exports, logs and notifications. Staff, missionary and public surfaces
SHALL consume separately authorized projections. Prayer/visit records SHALL NOT
become care case notes, location dossiers or permission grants. Retention,
redaction/anonymization and backups follow governing owners; lawful history does
not mean indefinite unredacted retention. No new private-file store.

requirement_contracts.title: Clear accessible UX
requirement_contracts.text:
Use the shared Asym design system and record/task
patterns. Show current context, responsible person, actual request/response,
relevant financial details and next action. Provide deliberate Save, edit/record
response/close actions with truthful pending, success, denied and conflict states.
No default financial zero, required irrelevant field, drag-only action, fictional
stage progression, unannounced content change or compulsory narrative for an
ordinary permitted save. Mobile, keyboard, focus, locale and low-bandwidth recovery
are acceptance requirements, not optional polish.

requirement_contracts.title: Lossless conditional editing
requirement_contracts.text:
Changing applicable details SHALL NOT
silently discard entered work or submit hidden stale amounts. Current saved terms
and historical presented terms remain distinguishable. Omitted fields, explicit
absence, unknown, not applicable and denied/unloaded values SHALL NOT be collapsed
by forms, schemas, imports or projections. On unsafe stale state, preserve only
the draft content the current actor may still access and provide a clear recovery.

requirement_contracts.title: Financial reporting
requirement_contracts.text:
Report requested, forecast, response, source
commitment and source received/adjusted outcomes separately with coverage and
as-of meaning. Nonfinancial requests SHALL NOT lower monetary averages or inflate
funding totals; optional amount queries SHALL NOT make them vanish from ordinary
request counts. Do not add mutually exclusive proposals, recognition and gifts,
different currencies/entities, or repeated source coverage into an unlabeled
total. Any allocation/fulfillment claim requires the owning contract, not a
date/amount/Party match or copied financial status.

requirement_contracts.title: Recoverable secondary effects
requirement_contracts.text:
Preserve one permanent source-purpose
identity across native and optional configurable follow-up. After source commit,
delivery/materialization failures SHALL be visible and retryable without another
business effect. An ambiguous external success SHALL reconcile with the owner
before replay. Cancellation stops remaining intent, not a committed historical
effect; no source-success rollback is fabricated when a response is lost.

requirement_contracts.title: Safe adoption and traceability
requirement_contracts.text:
Census actual legacy/custom/demo/import
data before migration; never reinterpret a zero-value gift/task as nonfinancial
request or create historical acceptance from inferred data. Expand compatible
readers/constraints before enabling writers, qualify old/new combinations, and
quarantine ambiguous imports for accountable resolution. After new writes,
rollback SHALL preserve lawful request/history/effect identities and prohibit old
writers that cannot express them. Trace D22 clauses and acceptance evidence into
the glossary/PRD/OpenSpec/design/tasks/tickets/release record through their
canonical authoring sources when those workflows are invoked.

requirement_contracts.title: Independent meanings
requirement_contracts.text:
Planning membership, current contact eligibility,
presentation, response, actual participation, financial facts and human work SHALL
remain independent. Independently answerable requests SHALL preserve their terms,
speaker/capacity, qualifications and history. No response, checkbox, board move,
task completion or numerical goal attainment SHALL imply another domain outcome.
A statement from a pastor is recorded with known capacity; the title alone does
not prove organizational approval or financial instruction.
Conflicting accounts SHALL preserve their evidence and show that the response
needs clarification under the source's rules; the last saved contact reply SHALL
NOT automatically become the organization's authoritative answer.

requirement_contracts.title: Financial truth
requirement_contracts.text:
P13 effective contribution lines, P14 qualified legal/
recognition lenses, P15 intake and P16 commitment/fulfillment SHALL remain the
authorities. A reference SHALL NOT allocate money or establish fulfillment. Every
amount SHALL retain Legal Entity, currency, amount basis, source identity, period
and freshness. Distinct source money SHALL be counted once within a financial
measure; overlapping appeal totals SHALL not be added as disjoint. No sum of legal
and recognition lenses, silent FX, invented valuation or gift inference from
names/dates/amounts/source code is allowed. Exact received-toward-appeal coverage
requires a qualified association adapter; otherwise label it unavailable while
retaining permitted source facts and ordinary nonfinancial work. Corrections,
returns and refunds SHALL change current derived outcomes through source truth,
without rewriting prior responses or adding another money writer.
Requested amounts, staff forecasts, supporter responses, commitments and received
money SHALL not be added together. Apply only admitted line/amount coverage, not
the full gift header because one portion is related. Preserve the qualified source
monetary basis, including admitted charitable fee cover and finalized corrections;
no processor-fee subtraction, expected gift, noncash valuation or liquidation
proceeds substitution. Readers SHALL use a coherent source/association/coverage
revision, not a maximum of unrelated per-record cursors.

requirement_contracts.title: Temporal and correction meaning
requirement_contracts.text:
Preserve occurred-at precision separately
from server recorded-at, presented terms, current effective response and source
correction history. Do not fabricate dates or backdate permissions. A late response
or imported event SHALL not create historical outreach or replay old tasks. Purpose,
goal, financial applicability and reference edits SHALL preserve prior versions;
hiding a financial section SHALL not delete gifts or silently submit hidden values.
Source-qualified Party merge SHALL preserve conflicting planning/response facts
and financial donor history; unresolved collisions remain visible to authorized
repair staff without revealing hidden records or creating duplicates.

requirement_contracts.title: Coherent accessible interface
requirement_contracts.text:
The daily experience above SHALL preserve
shared design-system ownership, visible context, clear next actions, explicit
selection scope and truthful save/error/conflict feedback. Require WCAG 2.2 AA for
the composed flow, including keyboard/focus operation, text status announcements,
contrast, reflow and target size; do not mistake a shared primitive or axe pass for
complete accessibility. No drag-only financial/status mutation, compulsory wizard,
new dashboard language or donor-value rating. Current scope and relevant options
must be understandable without documentation or facilitator correction.

requirement_contracts.title: Separate authority
requirement_contracts.text:
Reporting, viewing, routing, financial entry/posting,
  correction, receipts and fulfillment SHALL use their own current qualified actions.
  Possession, assignment, role labels and appeal membership SHALL grant none.

requirement_contracts.title: Scoped identity and evidence
requirement_contracts.text:
Required source keys/FKs, actor attribution,
  legal-entity-bearing relationships and allowed resulting states SHALL be enforced
  across commands, grants/RLS, views/functions, imports and privileged paths.

requirement_contracts.title: Same-item continuation
requirement_contracts.text:
Reporters and finance SHALL continue the same
  source intake. Exact lineage SHALL survive moves/carry-forward; duplicate reports
  and existing recorded gifts SHALL reconcile without duplicate contributions.

requirement_contracts.title: Exact resolution
requirement_contracts.text:
Only qualified source evidence for the exact covered
  occurrence SHALL resolve recording. Amount/date/donor/check-number similarity,
  a generic status, task completion or incomplete coverage SHALL NOT suffice.

requirement_contracts.title: Independent dimensions
requirement_contracts.text:
Recording, physical handling/deposit, clearance,
  appeal membership, requests, commitment and fulfillment SHALL remain distinct.
  Posting SHALL NOT close independently required handling; transfer SHALL NOT post.

requirement_contracts.title: Truthful exceptions/history
requirement_contracts.text:
Loss, return, rejection, dispute, mistake and
  duplicate dispositions SHALL retain lawful evidence and exact remaining work.
  Source archive/appeal closure/member removal SHALL NOT discard unresolved handling.

requirement_contracts.title: Concurrency and retry
requirement_contracts.text:
Material source heads and owner fences SHALL order
  competing changes. Same-intent retry SHALL preserve one effect and historical
  results; changed intent SHALL conflict and stale replay SHALL NOT overwrite later
  disposition. Incidental notes, display or assignment edits SHALL NOT erase
  accepted financial lineage or restart recording by themselves. Current result
  disclosure SHALL be independently reauthorized.

requirement_contracts.title: Honest money
requirement_contracts.text:
Pending reports SHALL NOT enter recorded-funding, settlement,
  public-progress or fulfillment totals. Qualified displayed amounts SHALL retain
  entity, currency, unit and meaning; unknown/noncash SHALL NOT become cash value.

Exercise fault injection before commit, after authoritative commit and during projection recovery. Retained-data/mixed-client/kill/restore and measured admitted workload proof ship with this behavior. Use current report/route/financial authorities independently, race recipient loss against capture/reassignment/completion/result reads, and reassign through source commands rather than a copied appeal queue. C-01 remains an external gate for financial-correction execution, not ordinary handling. P27-Q03 owns the complete AC27-F61-06 lifecycle composition across actual appeal closure/member removal and physical/carry/identity source producers; this slice independently proves its source-preserved obligations and dispositions without requiring appeal dispatch to operate physical handling.
command_validation: Commands exist in inspected develop package.json or invoke the existing Vitest binary with verified prior-art files. They were inspected, not executed as P27 runtime proof; feature-specific tests do not exist yet. Migration verifier requires a disposable localhost DATABASE_URL; real browser environment must be provisioned without demo fallback. Root unit wrapper does not forward per-file arguments, hence focused tests use bunx vitest run.
constraints: Business changes execute once through packages/api and Asym Postgres; app routes are thin, browser collections are authorized projections. Tenant, actor and audit attribution come from trusted current acting context, not caller input.

Each mutation re-proves applicable source/capability/field/purpose authority, validates same-Tenant composite relationships and the permitted old-to-new row transformation, and commits source state, history, semantic receipt and required work intent atomically. Ordinary grants, actual RLS USING/WITH CHECK, invoker/definer/RPC/service/import paths and zero-row updates require proof.

Expected material source revision orders competing intent. Same intent returns its current-authorized original receipt; changed payload under one key conflicts; replay never overwrites newer state. Missing/denied/incomplete/updating/source-unavailable are never known empty, zero or successful.

Native source work uses ADR0183 permanent source-purpose identity and recipient ceiling. Optional Studio/Eve cannot create duplicate tasks, decide source facts, grant access or revive ended work. Required action has eligible accountability or a discoverable owned exception; no guessed queue or administrator broadcast.

Shared Base UI 1.9/base-maia/Zinc controls, record shell and TanStack table patterns remain canonical. Deliver keyboard and screen-reader flow, announced states, focus recovery, 320-CSS-pixel/zoom, Unicode/RTL/long labels, light/dark/reduced motion and safe low-bandwidth recovery with no default sensitive browser persistence.

Every slice ships its own source-scoped telemetry, applicable exact monitors, numeric measured workload/latency/recovery budget, bounded queries, upgrade/retained-data census, mixed-writer refusal, additive kill/roll-forward and restore proof. Later portfolio qualification does not defer this slice's safety, accessibility or operations.

No automatic charge, receipt, donor consent, public disclosure, missionary task/quota, rating or current cultivation enrollment follows from contextual Request/appeal/intake recording. Existing parties, ministries, payment and financial owners retain authority.

requirement_contracts.title: Explicit receipt evidence
requirement_contracts.text:
The source SHALL distinguish trusted recorder,
  reported receipt/handling and time, and next accountable responsibility. Drafts,
  promises, assignments and dating fields SHALL NOT imply current physical custody.

requirement_contracts.title: Honest incomplete intake
requirement_contracts.text:
Unknown donor, intended entity, amount or
  allocation SHALL have a bounded source-owned exception path without invented
  values, weakened financial-root constraints or a P27 shadow record.

requirement_contracts.title: Separate authority
requirement_contracts.text:
Reporting, viewing, routing, financial entry/posting,
  correction, receipts and fulfillment SHALL use their own current qualified actions.
  Possession, assignment, role labels and appeal membership SHALL grant none.

requirement_contracts.title: Scoped identity and evidence
requirement_contracts.text:
Required source keys/FKs, actor attribution,
  legal-entity-bearing relationships and allowed resulting states SHALL be enforced
  across commands, grants/RLS, views/functions, imports and privileged paths.

requirement_contracts.title: Same-item continuation
requirement_contracts.text:
Reporters and finance SHALL continue the same
  source intake. Exact lineage SHALL survive moves/carry-forward; duplicate reports
  and existing recorded gifts SHALL reconcile without duplicate contributions.

requirement_contracts.title: Exact resolution
requirement_contracts.text:
Only qualified source evidence for the exact covered
  occurrence SHALL resolve recording. Amount/date/donor/check-number similarity,
  a generic status, task completion or incomplete coverage SHALL NOT suffice.

requirement_contracts.title: Independent dimensions
requirement_contracts.text:
Recording, physical handling/deposit, clearance,
  appeal membership, requests, commitment and fulfillment SHALL remain distinct.
  Posting SHALL NOT close independently required handling; transfer SHALL NOT post.

requirement_contracts.title: Truthful exceptions/history
requirement_contracts.text:
Loss, return, rejection, dispute, mistake and
  duplicate dispositions SHALL retain lawful evidence and exact remaining work.
  Source archive/appeal closure/member removal SHALL NOT discard unresolved handling.

requirement_contracts.title: Eligible native work
requirement_contracts.text:
Actual next work SHALL reuse qualified source Tasks
  Hub/attention identity, current eligible routing and source-controlled closure.
  No duplicate appeal queue, guessed fallback or automatic donor contact is permitted.

requirement_contracts.title: Atomic local effects
requirement_contracts.text:
Accepted source changes, required evidence/work
  disposition and operation receipts/intents SHALL commit coherently. Projection
  failure SHALL NOT falsify acceptance; independent posted money SHALL survive
  consumer failure and SHALL NOT be reposted to repair the consumer.

requirement_contracts.title: Concurrency and retry
requirement_contracts.text:
Material source heads and owner fences SHALL order
  competing changes. Same-intent retry SHALL preserve one effect and historical
  results; changed intent SHALL conflict and stale replay SHALL NOT overwrite later
  disposition. Incidental notes, display or assignment edits SHALL NOT erase
  accepted financial lineage or restart recording by themselves. Current result
  disclosure SHALL be independently reauthorized.

requirement_contracts.title: Honest money
requirement_contracts.text:
Pending reports SHALL NOT enter recorded-funding, settlement,
  public-progress or fulfillment totals. Qualified displayed amounts SHALL retain
  entity, currency, unit and meaning; unknown/noncash SHALL NOT become cash value.

requirement_contracts.title: Minimal protected data
requirement_contracts.text:
Report facts, references, counts, tasks, logs,
  exports, caches and history SHALL obey current field/purpose floors and retention.
  D25 SHALL introduce no check images, raw bank/card fields, OCR or file-store bypass.

requirement_contracts.title: Clear accessible flow
requirement_contracts.text:
The shared interface SHALL show known facts,
  uncertainty, next responsibility and permitted actions without duplicate entry,
  mandatory extra approval, exclusive supporter-status distortion or blind retry.
  The actual browser SHALL pass the concrete accessibility/recovery cases below.

requirement_contracts.title: Safe rollout and restore
requirement_contracts.text:
Reconcile the narrow P15 extension and qualify
  source scope/routing/lineage before activation. Migration, mixed writers and
  rollback SHALL preserve accepted evidence and current restrictions; restore SHALL
  reconcile current source truth before affected readers/workers resume.

requirement_contracts.title: Measured operations
requirement_contracts.text:
Numeric admitted workloads, query/command/recovery
  budgets, retry ceilings and named operating owners SHALL be established from
  measured source-shaped tests before release; no silent truncation or scale claim.

requirement_contracts.title: Traceable proof
requirement_contracts.text:
D25's glossary, owner extension, R/AC outcomes, future
  formal requirements/design/tasks and real release evidence SHALL agree. Synthetic
  resolution mechanics SHALL NOT be promoted to financial, RLS, custody or UI proof.

implementation_evidence.evidence: Current read composes donors/missionaries/profiles/donor_pledges/member_care and paginates after in-memory sorting. It is not the identified Ministry Assignment, P27 Request or appeal writer; do not reuse its implicit financial/care joins as authority.
Canonical parse/execute contract is precedent for small source commands; this feature must implement its own domain decisions, not route through legacy contribution actions.

Contribution helper guesses finance_operations and performs task/link/event writes in successive calls. Reuse qualified shared contract, not this helper as proof of atomic source work or eligible routing.

monitors.signal: Unresolved physical-gift responsibility silently disappears or recording falsely completes handling
monitors.response: Contain the closing/cleanup path, recover source responsibility and physical handling through authorized operations, correct the projection.

monitors.signal: Human handling action exceeds its source-owned due/review date
monitors.owner: Current P15 accountable handler; intake lead for routing exceptions
monitors.response: Review the actual obstruction/handling, update source next action and existing attention; no automatic donor solicitation or bank-clearance inference.

monitors.signal: Pilot user confuses possession, assignment, posting or clearance, or enters a second gift
monitors.response: Revise the flow/wording and retest before pilot expansion. No assumed safety from primitive accessibility alone.

operating_monitors.signal: Accepted fresh selection references a stage already retired at acceptance, or scoped relationship/history invariant fails
operating_monitors.response: Stop affected new writes, preserve evidence, investigate all writers and repair via source; activate wider incident handling if scope unknown.

operating_monitors.signal: Unauthorized tenant/entity/catalog/history/usage disclosure
operating_monitors.response: Contain the affected route/cache/export, revoke unsafe access, assess exposure and follow security incident procedure. Never merely monitor continued leakage.

operating_monitors.signal: Configuration projection still behind source after a completed reconciliation attempt
operating_monitors.response: Mark affected view stale, inspect scoped outbox/projection status, retry/repair without reapplying source change.

operating_monitors.signal: One business-effect key produces multiple accepted configuration outcomes
operating_monitors.response: Disable affected replay/write path, reconcile provenance and fix effect deduplication before re-enable.

operating_monitors.signal: Configuration transaction timeout or deadlock failure
operating_monitors.threshold: Three such failures within 15 minutes for the same tenant/preset; proposed operational trigger, not a measured SLO
operating_monitors.response: Inspect scoped plans/contention; bound or pause the offending optional operation and correct index/query/batch behavior. Numeric request budgets and database timeouts must be qualified before activation under R17/AC16.

operating_monitors.signal: A usability pilot user cannot locate retained retired-stage work, confuses configuration with a journey change, or must use a pointer drag
operating_monitors.response: Correct interaction/wording and rerun the affected acceptance task before broader rollout. No unsupported percentage target.

what_to_build: Version meaningful presented and revised terms and staff forecast separately, preserving original attribution/time. A fresh authorized command can identify an older actually presented version for late evidence; stale editing of a replaced current head conflicts. Show which terms the answer addresses and what changed. Preserve day-only/unknown dates without DST fabrication. Serialize competing revise/respond/close/owner mutations and changed-intent retry; delayed acknowledgments never replace newer facts.
context: Expected-head control cannot prohibit truthful late history: reread current state then deliberately target the older presented version. The fixed review-field basis will consume term identities, not incidental Request revision.
non_goals: No new generic workflow, event-sourcing, list, approval, financial or task engine.
acceptance: AC27-F05-02: Given a presented monetary Request with an earlier staff forecast, when revising requested terms and the forecast, then reading both histories, then Revise a presented request and a staff forecast: original terms, what was actually presented, revised terms and prior forecast remain independently reconstructible without reading today's labels as historical fact.

AC27-F05-03: Given a Request with replaced terms and an earlier presented version, when submitting a stale edit and separately recording a late reply deliberately against that earlier version, then A stale edit against replaced terms conflicts explicitly. A fresh authorized recording can deliberately identify older presented terms for a late response; it does not relabel that response against current terms. Corrected occurrence evidence retains original recording and correction history. Day-only dates and daylight-saving boundaries do not imply a fabricated instant.

requirement_contracts.title: Presentation, revision and forecast history
requirement_contracts.text:
The system SHALL distinguish
draft preparation, actual presentation, current revised terms and earlier
presented terms. Response evidence SHALL identify the terms it addresses. Original
and revised requested terms and staff forecast versions SHALL remain lawfully
traceable; later outcome SHALL NOT rewrite the forecast that preceded it. A
correction and a genuinely new proposal SHALL be distinguishable.

A fresh, currently authorized recording MAY identify an older presented version
for a late response; current-revision checks prevent stale writes, not truthful
recording about historical terms.

requirement_contracts.title: Honest response
requirement_contracts.text:
Record the actual known response, speaker/capacity,
occurrence precision, recording time and trusted recorder. No answer, positive,
partial/conditional, declined and deferred meanings SHALL remain distinct;
withdrawal is not a supporter decline. Record already-made requests/responses
together without fictional intermediate transitions. Recording a fact SHALL NOT
claim that the action was authorized, compliant, delivered or legally binding.

requirement_contracts.title: Atomic source mutation and replay
requirement_contracts.text:
Accept the intended source change,
required lawful history, durable business result and required effect intent
atomically. Check current authority and expected source/terms revisions. Durable
replay SHALL be bound to tenant/source/business purpose and normalized semantic
payload; changed terms with the same identity conflict. A retry of a formerly
successful action SHALL NOT reapply it over newer state. Distinguish current
authorization to disclose a result from the original accepted effect.

requirement_contracts.title: Recoverable secondary effects
requirement_contracts.text:
Preserve one permanent source-purpose
identity across native and optional configurable follow-up. After source commit,
delivery/materialization failures SHALL be visible and retryable without another
business effect. An ambiguous external success SHALL reconcile with the owner
before replay. Cancellation stops remaining intent, not a committed historical
effect; no source-success rollback is fabricated when a response is lost.

requirement_contracts.title: Independent meanings
requirement_contracts.text:
Planning membership, current contact eligibility,
presentation, response, actual participation, financial facts and human work SHALL
remain independent. Independently answerable requests SHALL preserve their terms,
speaker/capacity, qualifications and history. No response, checkbox, board move,
task completion or numerical goal attainment SHALL imply another domain outcome.
A statement from a pastor is recorded with known capacity; the title alone does
not prove organizational approval or financial instruction.
Conflicting accounts SHALL preserve their evidence and show that the response
needs clarification under the source's rules; the last saved contact reply SHALL
NOT automatically become the organization's authoritative answer.

requirement_contracts.title: Temporal and correction meaning
requirement_contracts.text:
Preserve occurred-at precision separately
from server recorded-at, presented terms, current effective response and source
correction history. Do not fabricate dates or backdate permissions. A late response
or imported event SHALL not create historical outreach or replay old tasks. Purpose,
goal, financial applicability and reference edits SHALL preserve prior versions;
hiding a financial section SHALL not delete gifts or silently submit hidden values.
Source-qualified Party merge SHALL preserve conflicting planning/response facts
and financial donor history; unresolved collisions remain visible to authorized
repair staff without revealing hidden records or creating duplicates.

requirement_contracts.title: Responsibility and follow-through
requirement_contracts.text:
Each request SHALL preserve its
responsibility history. Outstanding request work SHALL have current eligible
accountability and visible next work or an owned actionable exception. Closed
work with no remaining obligation SHALL NOT require a new task, review date or
currently employed replacement owner just to retain or correct its history.
An appropriate source-qualified shared task MAY cover related request work; do
not duplicate it or invent a generic multi-source task graph. Every active
enrollment retains the existing next-task/due-date or owned-exception invariant.
A closed request with a remaining independent obligation must retain that obligation
and its eligible accountability, rather than use closure to hide it.
Task completion SHALL NOT change response or fulfillment by inference.

requirement_contracts.title: Lifecycle independence
requirement_contracts.text:
Request edits/closure/response SHALL NOT silently
change partnership stage, pause/review/closure, Party lifecycle, other requests,
communication eligibility or independent obligations. Late evidence and corrections
SHALL preserve earlier facts and recording provenance. Genuine resumed partnership
work follows D8; ended child effects SHALL NOT revive automatically.

requirement_contracts.title: Tenant and actor safety
requirement_contracts.text:
Derive tenant, actor, recorder, authority and
audit attribution from trusted server context. Caller-selected assignees,
subjects, lists, financial references and source links require current eligibility
proof. Parent and child relationships SHALL be tenant/source aware independently
of nullable financial references. Disallow generic patches that can transform a
permitted row into a foreign, differently owned or historically rewritten state.

requirement_contracts.title: Bounded implementation and operations
requirement_contracts.text:
Use tenant/source/owner/status/due
queries appropriate to real views, indexed qualified references and bounded page
sizes. Avoid loading every request/history/gift before rendering one record or
doing authorization per row through unbounded remote calls. Set and prove actual
input/page/batch/range budgets from the supported workload before activation;
do not invent capacity claims here. Expose recovery/reassignment through authorized
product controls, not recurring direct database repair.

what_to_build: Provide explicit Remove from working list, Exclude from this appeal and Return to list actions. Exclusion can be recorded for an eligible-to-record candidate never included; it is not global consent or donor refusal. Plain Add/import/retry skips Removed/Excluded. Return shows previous disposition and rechecks head/eligibility, restoring planning only. Keep churches and human contact identity distinct so changing the representative cannot bypass the same organization restriction. Record actual late facts without re-inclusion. Current-source fence advancement and required history/receipt are atomic, with conflict/recovery and accessible focus when a row leaves the filter.
context: No Return revives ended tasks/reviews/messages; no Remove recalls admitted communication or erases history. Critical pilot misunderstanding of planned-versus-asked or remove-versus-recall blocks expansion.
non_goals: No new generic workflow, event-sourcing, list, approval, financial or task engine.
acceptance: AC27-F39-01: Given an included Party and an eligible candidate never previously included, when removing the former and excluding either from the appeal, then Remove preserves lawful requests/responses and history. Exclude records an appeal-specific restriction, including an eligible-to-record candidate not previously included. Neither changes global consent or records a donor decline.

AC27-F41-01: Given removed/excluded membership with completed tasks and messages, when trying ordinary Add/import/retry, then deliberate authorized Return, then Plain Add/import/retry skips removed/excluded entries. Explicit Return shows previous disposition, checks current expected head and eligibility, and restores planning only; no ended tasks/reviews/messages revive.

AC27-F39-02: Given removed, excluded or stopped appeal work and a truthful late reply, when recording the actual past Request or response, then Record real late/past request or response after removal/exclusion, including stopped work, without re-inclusion, fabricated Asked/approval or automatic contact.

AC27-F39-04: Given a church and distinct pastor, spouse, household, advisor and donor identities, when selecting contacts and applying an organization appeal exclusion, then Church, pastor, household, spouse, legal donor and advisor identities are not conflated by email/address/name. Changing human contact cannot bypass the same organization's appeal exclusion; unrelated personal scope is independently evaluated.

AC27-F41-02: Given competing Add, Exclude and current-head changes, when executing controlled schedules, exact replay and changed-payload key reuse, then Controlled concurrent inclusion/exclusion in both orders, competing current-head changes, same-intent duplicates and changed payload under same operation key have one coherent outcome; exclusion cannot be overwritten by stale Add.

AC27-F50-01: Given the actual mobile list with long translated/RTL names and poor connectivity, when testing reflow, contrast, reduced motion, reconnect and safe input recovery, then Real UI passes 320-CSS-pixel/equivalent zoom, RTL, long names/translations, contrast and reduced-motion tests. Slow network/reconnect preserves safe input/result recovery without default sensitive browser persistence.

AC27-F40-04: Given old/new clients, jobs and schema during staged rollout, when writing or disabling membership and consuming affected events, then Mixed old/new clients/jobs, additive migration and activation gates reject writers that cannot honor disposition/current-head/receipt semantics. requirement_contracts.title: Separate facts
requirement_contracts.text:
Planned inclusion, current eligibility, actual requests,
  responses, commitment, received money and communication outcomes SHALL retain
  their distinct source meanings. Membership SHALL create none of the other facts.

requirement_contracts.title: Stable scoped identity
requirement_contracts.text:
Each appeal SHALL have at most one current entry
  for the same qualified Party in its Tenant/source scope, with complete scoped
  references and retained provenance. Organizations SHALL NOT expand into recipients
  and weak matching SHALL NOT merge distinct people or organizations.

requirement_contracts.title: Deliberate dispositions
requirement_contracts.text:
Add, Remove, Exclude and Return SHALL follow the
  lifecycle table. Plain Add/import/retry SHALL skip retained removed/excluded
  entries; only an explicit currently authorized Return may restore inclusion.

requirement_contracts.title: Current authority
requirement_contracts.text:
Candidate discovery, counts, group capture, each member
  effect, history, result replay, export and outward use SHALL prove their current
  exact actor/field/purpose/source permissions. Assignment or membership SHALL grant
  none. Unknown authority SHALL NOT be treated as permission or zero coverage.

requirement_contracts.title: Current restrictions
requirement_contracts.text:
New actionable inclusion and solicitation SHALL
  respect current applicable never-ask/contact restrictions. Existing history SHALL
  not be rewritten or erased to represent current restriction. Appeal exclusions
  SHALL NOT be used to modify global consent, or bypassed through alternate contacts
  representing the same excluded organization/purpose.

requirement_contracts.title: Finite group intent
requirement_contracts.text:
A group operation SHALL bind exact intended identities,
  action and source scope, distinguish selected page/all results, and record a
  coherent bounded capture. It SHALL NOT recapture a changing filter on retry.

requirement_contracts.title: Atomic member outcomes
requirement_contracts.text:
Each accepted member effect, required local history,
  receipt and actual required producer-fence advancement/supersession SHALL be atomic
  through the qualified owner transaction. Only permitted secondary effects may be
  deferred through durable intent; a fence-update outbox alone is insufficient.
  Independent outcomes may be
  partial; accepted work SHALL survive other members' failures and cancellation.

requirement_contracts.title: Concurrency and idempotency
requirement_contracts.text:
Relevant expected heads and owner fences SHALL
  serialize competing state/authority changes. Same-intent retries SHALL not duplicate
  or reapply effects; changed intent SHALL conflict; old receipts SHALL not replace
  current membership. Ordinary Add SHALL not override a newer removal/exclusion.

requirement_contracts.title: Precise outward effect
requirement_contracts.text:
Solicitation whose qualified producer purpose
  depends on appeal working membership SHALL use continuing inclusion as a current
  producer predicate through P6/P32 before
  dispatch admission. Removal/exclusion SHALL fence affected not-yet-admitted work,
  preserve in-flight/unknown truth and never cancel independent owner work merely
  because it has an appeal link. Return
  SHALL not revive ended effects; absent adapter qualification SHALL block activation.

requirement_contracts.title: Existing work and historical facts
requirement_contracts.text:
List edits SHALL preserve actual
  requests/responses/financial facts. Historical entry remains possible without
  re-adding the Party. Source-backed tasks SHALL follow exact actionable predicates;
  membership, filter refresh and generic completion SHALL not start/end other facts.

requirement_contracts.title: Minimal governed data
requirement_contracts.text:
Store minimal classified membership/provenance and
  lawful history, with current source projections for contact detail. Manifests,
  reasons, logs, caches, exports and backups SHALL obey the same authority and
  disposal boundaries; no default contact-directory snapshot or protected payload copy.

requirement_contracts.title: Clear accessible interface
requirement_contracts.text:
Use shared Core UI, explicit actions, clear
  selection scope, understandable disposition/eligibility/history and truthful
  pending/partial/conflict/recovery feedback. The real browser SHALL meet the
  concrete keyboard, screen-reader, reflow and low-bandwidth cases above.

requirement_contracts.title: Safe upgrade and restore
requirement_contracts.text:
Additive schema, compatible writers/readers,
  current source fences and data census SHALL precede activation. Imports/backfills
  SHALL not invent planning intent or outreach; disabling a consumer SHALL not
  waive restrictions. Rollback/restore SHALL preserve new accepted history and
  re-prove current exclusion/identity/access/disposal before affected work resumes.

requirement_contracts.title: Traceability and proof
requirement_contracts.text:
D24/glossary/owner mappings SHALL trace into future
  requirements/design/tasks and actual implementation/tests/release evidence.
  Required negative, concurrency, migration and UX cases below SHALL be proven;
  research examples and synthetic mechanics SHALL not be claimed as deployed proof.

Contribution helper guesses finance_operations and performs task/link/event writes in successive calls. Reuse qualified shared contract, not this helper as proof of atomic source work or eligible routing.

monitors.response: Revise language/composition and retest before pilot expansion; do not default to more mandatory dialogs.

title: Withdraw a list from new use while existing work continues
delivers: Configurators can stop and restore new use of a list while existing assessed, unassessed and returning partnership work continues on its retained binding.

Restore does not restore old default/grants/tasks or move work back. Authorized settings/current filters/history/reports retain records and helpful restoration/zero-choice paths. Unknown or hidden dependencies never leak through success/rejection.

acceptance_source_text.AC27-P17-02:
**Given** Available or withdrawn lists and the stated existing, returning or proposed work.
**When** new-use availability changes or admission/continued-use operations are exercised.
**Then** every stated observable result and invariant below SHALL hold, with the specified fixtures and boundary cases included in verification:

Withdraw an available list: new admission cannot use it, while previously attached assessed work can select available stages forward, backward or by skipping. One normal stage event records an actual change; withdrawal creates none.

New admission becomes possible only when current applicability and other checks pass. An applicable current naming collision requires permitted explicit resolution or rejection, without silent rename, merge or disclosure.

acceptance_source_text.AC27-P19-07:
**Given** The stated catalog coverage, usual-list setting, established intent and authorization.
**When** initialization, configuration, refetch, withdrawal or a dependent start occurs.

Race Set A with withdrawal in both orders; exercise stale expected revision, pre-replaced B and prior clearing. No accepted default points outside its qualified scope or to a list unavailable for new work; starter-specific inability to discover/use it prevents application without clearing the organization setting; withdrawal clears only expressly included matching A. Failure of required history/result rolls back the combined source mutation.

operating_monitors.response: Disable the affected admission/attachment door, preserve receipts/history, identify affected work and correct through the source; involve P12/security if authority failed.

operating_monitors.signal: Existing stage operation denied solely by whole-list withdrawal, or existing work omitted by that filter
operating_monitors.owner: P27 engineering with P28 surface owner
operating_monitors.response: Repair the eligibility/read path; reconcile affected projections. Do not make the list available for new work as a workaround.

operating_monitors.signal: Retained usable catalog has zero selectable stages
operating_monitors.response: Block unsafe further configuration/selection, retain unrelated work, perform authorized audited repair and identify the failing writer.

operating_monitors.signal: Accepted configuration lacks required history/result, or same intent has duplicate business effects
operating_monitors.response: Contain the affected mutation path, reconcile from authoritative evidence, repair without deleting accepted history and verify retry safety.

operating_monitors.signal: Unauthorized tenant/context/history/count disclosure
operating_monitors.response: Contain affected access/cache/export, apply existing incident procedure and verify scope/revocation before reopening.

operating_monitors.signal: Staff misinterpret list retirement as ending a partnership or stopping follow-up
operating_monitors.threshold: Any validated report or observed usability failure
operating_monitors.response: Reproduce the flow, correct wording/hierarchy/behavior and retest affected scenarios; investigate missed work where applicable.

**When** the actual mutation protocol runs through the stated races, retries or injected failures.

title: Preserve source work through representative handoff and departure
delivers: A representative change either preserves lawful independent responsibility or observes the exact source-owned handoff condition; departure never waits to revoke access.

blockers.contract: Named responsibility mutation and safe blocked-work boundary
blockers.reason: The handoff condition must fence the actual assignment acceptance, not a later UI check.

blockers.contract: Partnership responsibility handoff and the inherited P27-P01 bounded source-work adapter
blockers.reason: The acceptance path must inspect and preserve actual current partnership ownership and task predicates, not generic qualifications or a simulated handoff.

blockers.contract: Actual Request readiness, responsibility and covered source work
blockers.reason: The transfer cannot claim real Request-work validity without the Request owner state and next-work contract.

prerequisites: Specification integration: the focused Phase 27 documentation PR must be merged or its exact approved specification revision explicitly integrated into the implementation branch; the unmerged target branch does not yet carry this contract.

Qualify the exact consumed current-authorization components and source revisions before delivery/runtime use. Agreed producer interfaces allow preparation, but a producer issue being closed or a pure fixture passing is not an actual-role/RLS qualification packet. No whole future phase is a substitute dependency.

Before admitting each affected source lane, qualify its current work/responsibility predicate, authorized disposition/acceptance command, durable occurrence/intent and permitted discovery/recipient contract. No entire P34/P44 dependency is required.

ADR0183 task and ADR0027 notification adapters must prove only their actual source-human work. Missing/unknown resolver or no eligible recipient releases nobody and remains discoverable at the qualified source; do not invent a fallback queue.
what_to_build: Connect the exact source-owned affected-work predicate to representative transfer and its repair UI. A partnership lead, Request/task owner, commitment and care responsibility do not automatically move. When lawful work ownership remains valid, transfer may proceed without fabricated handoff chores. Where work would lose eligible responsibility, require the source-approved disposition or durable owned handoff. Exact pre-transfer acceptance gates the commit; a separately subsequent acknowledgment stays outstanding after lawful assignment plus durable intent. Staff departure/revocation immediately denies access while authorized source repair continues.
context: Current Mission Control task creation inserts task, links and event separately and its assignment helper defaults to actor-and-queue. Neither supplies a qualified source-owned D30 handoff contract. Source actions and Tasks Hub projection must remain distinct; no generic task Done means acceptance.
non_goals: No universal second-person approval or handoff wizard, distributed transaction to complete every obligation, automatic work-owner transfer, guessed successor/primary/queue, donor message or invented Website return/coordination policy.
acceptance: AC27-A08-01: Given a Party has independently owned partnership work, Requests, tasks, access and financial obligations; When a representative transfer is accepted or a transfer proposal is created; Then Representative transfer does not move partnership/Request/task ownership, grant access, start cultivation, send donor messages or generate a task for every proposal.

AC27-A07-02: Given affected work has a qualified owner condition requiring acceptance before transfer, or a different condition allowing acknowledgment afterward; When the proposed representative change is attempted with and without the exact prerequisite or durable owned handoff disposition; Then Where affected required work would lose eligible responsibility, require lawful source disposition/durable owned handoff. Source-required pre-transfer acceptance gates assignment commit; subsequent acknowledgment remains visibly outstanding after lawful assignment plus durable intent. Neither acknowledgment nor handoff completion is fabricated.

AC27-A07-03: Given a staff member has active responsibility and outstanding work or handoff; When the identity or permission owner deactivates the person or revokes the applicable authority while transfer review is incomplete; Then Staff departure/revocation acts immediately despite pending review/handoff; no successor is inferred from directory fields and no ineligible assignee appears as healthy current coverage.

Loss of access hides unauthorized source details immediately without marking obligations complete. Acknowledgment read state is not receiving acceptance; exact owner-authorized acceptance retains its own meaning.

Operating MON27-137: any confirmed required work losing eligible accountability without lawful disposition stops the affected transfer path; the source owner repairs responsibility without reviving access.

MON27-137 operation: signal Required work loses accountable eligible responsibility without lawful disposition; threshold Any confirmed occurrence; accountable role Development operations owner + affected work owner; response Surface source repair, stop affected transfer path and restore qualified responsibility without resurrecting access or fabricating completion. Assign an actual operator before affected activation.

requirement_contracts.title: Owner boundaries
requirement_contracts.text:
Positive response SHALL NOT create a pledge, recurring
agreement, charge, gift, consent, subscription, referral edge, appointment, booking
or application. Any deliberate handoff SHALL use the qualified owning command,
current authority, explicit scope and durable result identity. Unavailable owner
capability SHALL leave a visible actionable state, never a local shadow substitute.
Required native internal follow-through SHALL work without Phase 34 or 42.

requirement_contracts.title: Minimized disclosure
requirement_contracts.text:
Apply P12 field/purpose/existence rules to request
content, contacts, history, attachments, source links, search, caches, summaries,
counts, exports, logs and notifications. Staff, missionary and public surfaces
SHALL consume separately authorized projections. Prayer/visit records SHALL NOT
become care case notes, location dossiers or permission grants. Retention,
redaction/anonymization and backups follow governing owners; lawful history does
not mean indefinite unredacted retention. No new private-file store.

requirement_contracts.title: Financial reporting
requirement_contracts.text:
Report requested, forecast, response, source
commitment and source received/adjusted outcomes separately with coverage and
as-of meaning. Nonfinancial requests SHALL NOT lower monetary averages or inflate
funding totals; optional amount queries SHALL NOT make them vanish from ordinary
request counts. Do not add mutually exclusive proposals, recognition and gifts,
different currencies/entities, or repeated source coverage into an unlabeled
total. Any allocation/fulfillment claim requires the owning contract, not a
date/amount/Party match or copied financial status.

requirement_contracts.title: Bounded policy
Authority separation
requirement_contracts.text:
Preparation, submission, requirement administration,
  exception, decision, reassignment, correction and presentation SHALL resolve current
  exact P12 powers independently. Assignment and role labels SHALL grant none of them.

requirement_contracts.title: Reviewer eligibility
requirement_contracts.text:
Required review SHALL have one current qualified
  internal reviewer or a visible source-owned recovery condition. Allowed self-review
  SHALL be deliberate; actual separation floors SHALL use stable person identity.

requirement_contracts.title: Exact review target
requirement_contracts.text:
Decisions SHALL bind the exact source-owned business
  terms/version and prospective action. Source-defined reviewed-field changes SHALL
  supersede coverage; unrelated metadata SHALL NOT create another review.

requirement_contracts.title: Deliberate lifecycle
requirement_contracts.text:
Submission, decision, withdrawal, reassignment,
  resubmission and prospective correction/revocation SHALL follow the lifecycle table,
  preserve history and never fabricate donor refusal or revive ended work.

requirement_contracts.title: Current applicability
requirement_contracts.text:
Future supported actions SHALL use current required
  review coverage and source authority. Policy changes SHALL preserve explicit choices
  and historical facts, and SHALL never automatically send. Unrelated routing changes
  or reviewer departure alone SHALL NOT invalidate an accepted decision.

requirement_contracts.title: Shared work
requirement_contracts.text:
Review and actionable recovery SHALL use registered source
  work and safe attention contracts. Generic task completion, notification read or
  timeout SHALL NOT decide; absent/indeterminate recipients SHALL release no fallback.

requirement_contracts.title: Minimal disclosure
requirement_contracts.text:
Reviewers SHALL receive a sufficient currently authorized
  view of relevant terms; protected bodies SHALL NOT be copied into general tasks,
  logs, messages, exports or caches without separately qualified exact projection.

requirement_contracts.title: Database invariants
requirement_contracts.text:
Complete scoped relationships, finite valid values,
  one pending target and one terminal decision per round SHALL be enforced by database
  constraints and one authoritative command boundary, including privileged paths.

requirement_contracts.title: Atomic acceptance and races
requirement_contracts.text:
Relevant current-head validation, terminal
  decision, mandatory local evidence, receipt and downstream intent SHALL commit
  atomically; conflicting edits/decisions/policy/authority changes SHALL have one
  coherent ordered result without stale clearance.

requirement_contracts.title: Durable retry
requirement_contracts.text:
Same business intent SHALL be idempotent across retries and
  deliveries; changed intent SHALL conflict; replay SHALL reauthorize its returned
  projection and SHALL NOT replace current truth with an old receipt.

requirement_contracts.title: Clear accessible UI
requirement_contracts.text:
The shared interface SHALL show meaningful current
  state, exact review scope, responsible next actor, permitted next action and change
  path; preserve relevant input, announce outcomes and distinguish failed/unknown/
  restricted states. It SHALL satisfy the concrete UX/browser cases above.

requirement_contracts.title: Independent native operation
requirement_contracts.text:
The complete native flow SHALL work without
  Studio, external approval vendors, a second inbox, a rule builder or an invented
  timer. Optional orchestration SHALL consume the same source fact and effect identity.

requirement_contracts.title: Bounded operational qualification
requirement_contracts.text:
Tenant-scoped current lists, authorized
  counts, paginated history and source recovery SHALL have measured workload/query
  evidence, bounded retries and explicit operations ownership before release.

requirement_contracts.title: Proof and traceability
requirement_contracts.text:
Decision→glossary→owner mapping→future requirements/
  design/tasks→implementation/test/release evidence SHALL stay consistent. Actual
  authorization, concurrency, accessibility and rollout cases below SHALL be proven
  before claiming implementation readiness.
