requirement_contracts.title: Recorded planning intent
requirement_contracts.text:
Appeal membership SHALL change only through
  qualified explicit source actions. Later filter/query changes SHALL NOT mutate
  an accepted working list or the intended population of an admitted operation.

requirement_contracts.title: Current authority
requirement_contracts.text:
Candidate discovery, counts, group capture, each member
  effect, history, result replay, export and outward use SHALL prove their current
  exact actor/field/purpose/source permissions. Assignment or membership SHALL grant
  none. Unknown authority SHALL NOT be treated as permission or zero coverage.

requirement_contracts.title: Current restrictions
requirement_contracts.text:
New actionable inclusion and solicitation SHALL
  respect current applicable never-ask/contact restrictions. Existing history SHALL
  not be rewritten or erased to represent current restriction. Appeal exclusions
  SHALL NOT be used to modify global consent, or bypassed through alternate contacts
  representing the same excluded organization/purpose.

requirement_contracts.title: Finite group intent
requirement_contracts.text:
A group operation SHALL bind exact intended identities,
  action and source scope, distinguish selected page/all results, and record a
  coherent bounded capture. It SHALL NOT recapture a changing filter on retry.

requirement_contracts.title: Atomic member outcomes
requirement_contracts.text:
Each accepted member effect, required local history,
  receipt and actual required producer-fence advancement/supersession SHALL be atomic
  through the qualified owner transaction. Only permitted secondary effects may be
  deferred through durable intent; a fence-update outbox alone is insufficient.
  Independent outcomes may be
  partial; accepted work SHALL survive other members' failures and cancellation.

requirement_contracts.title: Concurrency and idempotency
requirement_contracts.text:
Relevant expected heads and owner fences SHALL
  serialize competing state/authority changes. Same-intent retries SHALL not duplicate
  or reapply effects; changed intent SHALL conflict; old receipts SHALL not replace
  current membership. Ordinary Add SHALL not override a newer removal/exclusion.

requirement_contracts.title: Precise outward effect
requirement_contracts.text:
Solicitation whose qualified producer purpose
  depends on appeal working membership SHALL use continuing inclusion as a current
  producer predicate through P6/P32 before
  dispatch admission. Removal/exclusion SHALL fence affected not-yet-admitted work,
  preserve in-flight/unknown truth and never cancel independent owner work merely
  because it has an appeal link. Return
  SHALL not revive ended effects; absent adapter qualification SHALL block activation.

requirement_contracts.title: Minimal governed data
requirement_contracts.text:
Store minimal classified membership/provenance and
  lawful history, with current source projections for contact detail. Manifests,
  reasons, logs, caches, exports and backups SHALL obey the same authority and
  disposal boundaries; no default contact-directory snapshot or protected payload copy.

requirement_contracts.title: Clear accessible interface
requirement_contracts.text:
Use shared Core UI, explicit actions, clear
  selection scope, understandable disposition/eligibility/history and truthful
  pending/partial/conflict/recovery feedback. The real browser SHALL meet the
  concrete keyboard, screen-reader, reflow and low-bandwidth cases above.

requirement_contracts.title: Measurement and operations
requirement_contracts.text:
Scoped lists/history, permission-safe counts,
  group execution, query plans, lock waits and reconciliation SHALL be measured
  against an explicit numeric admitted workload and named budgets before release.
  No undocumented silent caps or unmeasured capacity claim is permitted.

requirement_contracts.title: Traceability and proof
requirement_contracts.text:
D24/glossary/owner mappings SHALL trace into future
  requirements/design/tasks and actual implementation/tests/release evidence.
  Required negative, concurrency, migration and UX cases below SHALL be proven;
  research examples and synthetic mechanics SHALL not be claimed as deployed proof.

requirement_contracts.title: Correctness under concurrency
requirement_contracts.text:
A mutation SHALL atomically persist its
authoritative intent, lawful history and required durable effect intent, or none.
Use semantic idempotency tied to the actual operation, not only an HTTP retry.
Identical retries return the same lawful result; stale competing edits conflict
without overwriting newer terms or responses. Link/unlink, close/reopen, merge,
suppression/revocation and dispatch races SHALL use current revisions/fences with
defined ordering. Cancellation of a finite bulk operation retains committed members
and truthfully identifies unattempted/failed ones. Lost responses and ambiguous
external success reconcile through the existing owner before resending. No unproved
exactly-once claim across external providers.

requirement_contracts.title: Temporal and correction meaning
requirement_contracts.text:
Preserve occurred-at precision separately
from server recorded-at, presented terms, current effective response and source
correction history. Do not fabricate dates or backdate permissions. A late response
or imported event SHALL not create historical outreach or replay old tasks. Purpose,
goal, financial applicability and reference edits SHALL preserve prior versions;
hiding a financial section SHALL not delete gifts or silently submit hidden values.
Source-qualified Party merge SHALL preserve conflicting planning/response facts
and financial donor history; unresolved collisions remain visible to authorized
repair staff without revealing hidden records or creating duplicates.

requirement_contracts.title: Coherent accessible interface
requirement_contracts.text:
The daily experience above SHALL preserve
shared design-system ownership, visible context, clear next actions, explicit
selection scope and truthful save/error/conflict feedback. Require WCAG 2.2 AA for
the composed flow, including keyboard/focus operation, text status announcements,
contrast, reflow and target size; do not mistake a shared primitive or axe pass for
complete accessibility. No drag-only financial/status mutation, compulsory wizard,
new dashboard language or donor-value rating. Current scope and relevant options
must be understandable without documentation or facilitator correction.

requirement_contracts.title: Evidence and operations
requirement_contracts.text:
Business history SHALL show who changed which
source terms, reference, response or disposition and when. Security audit tracks
authorized actions/access; technical logs track operation/correlation/source-version
IDs and failures without sensitive content. A saved authoritative response SHALL not
be lost because a projection failed; expose pending update and replay durable effects.
Release proof SHALL include real source services, real role/grant/RLS tests,
concurrent schedules, mixed-version migration and observed staff UX. Unknown workload
or usability cannot be replaced by a fabricated performance number or claim of
perfection. Every monitored residual has an owner, threshold and response below.

AC27-F76-03: Given an already-presented invitation with reply and date-only or unknown occurrence, when saving both facts together, then Record an already-presented Request and reply in one save, with honest unknown/date-only precision and no fictional intermediate history.

requirement_contracts.title: Independent meanings
requirement_contracts.text:
Planning membership, current contact eligibility,
presentation, response, actual participation, financial facts and human work SHALL
remain independent. Independently answerable requests SHALL preserve their terms,
speaker/capacity, qualifications and history. No response, checkbox, board move,
task completion or numerical goal attainment SHALL imply another domain outcome.
A statement from a pastor is recorded with known capacity; the title alone does
not prove organizational approval or financial instruction.
Conflicting accounts SHALL preserve their evidence and show that the response
needs clarification under the source's rules; the last saved contact reply SHALL
NOT automatically become the organization's authoritative answer.

requirement_contracts.title: Exact relationships
requirement_contracts.text:
A same-tenant appeal–Request reference SHALL identify
one canonical Request and compatible purpose, checked under current permissions.
An appeal SHALL reference that Request at most once currently. Multiple relevant
appeals MAY reference the same Request without cloning facts or work; combined
views SHALL deduplicate its identity. Link/unlink SHALL be deliberate and audited,
shall not alter Request ownership, and shall not silently mutate the working list.
Historical links and unlink time SHALL remain interpretable under source retention.
No cascade delete SHALL erase Requests, responses or financial facts. Linking an
old Request SHALL NOT imply it was presented through the new appeal or backdate
that appeal's results. A newly distinct invitation needs its actual D22 terms and
response, not a borrowed acceptance.

requirement_contracts.title: Financial truth
requirement_contracts.text:
P13 effective contribution lines, P14 qualified legal/
recognition lenses, P15 intake and P16 commitment/fulfillment SHALL remain the
authorities. A reference SHALL NOT allocate money or establish fulfillment. Every
amount SHALL retain Legal Entity, currency, amount basis, source identity, period
and freshness. Distinct source money SHALL be counted once within a financial
measure; overlapping appeal totals SHALL not be added as disjoint. No sum of legal
and recognition lenses, silent FX, invented valuation or gift inference from
names/dates/amounts/source code is allowed. Exact received-toward-appeal coverage
requires a qualified association adapter; otherwise label it unavailable while
retaining permitted source facts and ordinary nonfinancial work. Corrections,
returns and refunds SHALL change current derived outcomes through source truth,
without rewriting prior responses or adding another money writer.
Requested amounts, staff forecasts, supporter responses, commitments and received
money SHALL not be added together. Apply only admitted line/amount coverage, not
the full gift header because one portion is related. Preserve the qualified source
monetary basis, including admitted charitable fee cover and finalized corrections;
no processor-fee subtraction, expected gift, noncash valuation or liquidation
proceeds substitution. Readers SHALL use a coherent source/association/coverage
revision, not a maximum of unrelated per-record cursors.

requirement_contracts.title: Real work and source effects
requirement_contracts.text:
Reuse ADR0183
and ADR0027.
Create work only for a proved actionable source occurrence, with eligible
responsibility and defined end semantics. Appeal membership, a new link, a response
or an ongoing agreement to pray SHALL NOT automatically create one task per person
or perpetual check-ins. Native and optional workflows SHALL use one durable
source-purpose identity; linking the source into another appeal SHALL not create
another task, notification or delivery. Independent actual obligations remain.

requirement_contracts.title: Correctness under concurrency
requirement_contracts.text:
A mutation SHALL atomically persist its
authoritative intent, lawful history and required durable effect intent, or none.
Use semantic idempotency tied to the actual operation, not only an HTTP retry.
Identical retries return the same lawful result; stale competing edits conflict
without overwriting newer terms or responses. Link/unlink, close/reopen, merge,
suppression/revocation and dispatch races SHALL use current revisions/fences with
defined ordering. Cancellation of a finite bulk operation retains committed members
and truthfully identifies unattempted/failed ones. Lost responses and ambiguous
external success reconcile through the existing owner before resending. No unproved
exactly-once claim across external providers.

requirement_contracts.title: Temporal and correction meaning
requirement_contracts.text:
Preserve occurred-at precision separately
from server recorded-at, presented terms, current effective response and source
correction history. Do not fabricate dates or backdate permissions. A late response
or imported event SHALL not create historical outreach or replay old tasks. Purpose,
goal, financial applicability and reference edits SHALL preserve prior versions;
hiding a financial section SHALL not delete gifts or silently submit hidden values.
Source-qualified Party merge SHALL preserve conflicting planning/response facts
and financial donor history; unresolved collisions remain visible to authorized
repair staff without revealing hidden records or creating duplicates.

requirement_contracts.title: Coherent accessible interface
requirement_contracts.text:
The daily experience above SHALL preserve
shared design-system ownership, visible context, clear next actions, explicit
selection scope and truthful save/error/conflict feedback. Require WCAG 2.2 AA for
the composed flow, including keyboard/focus operation, text status announcements,
contrast, reflow and target size; do not mistake a shared primitive or axe pass for
complete accessibility. No drag-only financial/status mutation, compulsory wizard,
new dashboard language or donor-value rating. Current scope and relevant options
must be understandable without documentation or facilitator correction.

implementation_evidence.evidence: Current read composes donors/missionaries/profiles/donor_pledges/member_care and paginates after in-memory sorting. It is not the identified Ministry Assignment, P27 Request or appeal writer; do not reuse its implicit financial/care joins as authority.
Canonical parse/execute contract is precedent for small source commands; this feature must implement its own domain decisions, not route through legacy contribution actions.

Contribution helper guesses finance_operations and performs task/link/event writes in successive calls. Reuse qualified shared contract, not this helper as proof of atomic source work or eligible routing.

Revoked NHI owner authority blocks automatic execution despite historical policy approval.

Only an outcome valid under the proved serialization order survives.

AC27-A11-02: Given queued decisions and callbacks from earlier policy generations exist, including a restored snapshot; When automatic changes are disabled and re-enabled, and stale, duplicate or out-of-order work is delivered; Then Disable/re-enable, stale queued events, duplicate/out-of-order callbacks and replay after restore cannot apply old desired-owner decisions or revive old grants/tasks.

requirement_contracts.title: Relevant monetary facts
requirement_contracts.text:
A current monetary request SHALL carry valid
explicit entity/currency and the meaning of each applicable amount; recurring or
multi-year terms SHALL retain cadence, term and reporting horizon where relevant.
Unknown requested/expected values SHALL remain unknown, never zero defaults.
Nonfinancial current terms SHALL have no monetary fields or financial total
contribution. Financial rows SHALL use exact currency-aware minor units with
defined range/scale handling, no floating point or implicit FX. Narrow noncash
intentions SHALL NOT require or invent a monetary valuation or received-gift fact.

requirement_contracts.title: Presentation, revision and forecast history
requirement_contracts.text:
The system SHALL distinguish
draft preparation, actual presentation, current revised terms and earlier
presented terms. Response evidence SHALL identify the terms it addresses. Original
and revised requested terms and staff forecast versions SHALL remain lawfully
traceable; later outcome SHALL NOT rewrite the forecast that preceded it. A
correction and a genuinely new proposal SHALL be distinguishable.

A fresh, currently authorized recording MAY identify an older presented version
for a late response; current-revision checks prevent stale writes, not truthful
recording about historical terms.

requirement_contracts.title: Financial reporting
requirement_contracts.text:
Report requested, forecast, response, source
commitment and source received/adjusted outcomes separately with coverage and
as-of meaning. Nonfinancial requests SHALL NOT lower monetary averages or inflate
funding totals; optional amount queries SHALL NOT make them vanish from ordinary
request counts. Do not add mutually exclusive proposals, recognition and gifts,
different currencies/entities, or repeated source coverage into an unlabeled
total. Any allocation/fulfillment claim requires the owning contract, not a
date/amount/Party match or copied financial status.

requirement_contracts.title: Bounded implementation and operations
requirement_contracts.text:
Use tenant/source/owner/status/due
queries appropriate to real views, indexed qualified references and bounded page
sizes. Avoid loading every request/history/gift before rendering one record or
doing authorization per row through unbounded remote calls. Set and prove actual
input/page/batch/range budgets from the supported workload before activation;
do not invent capacity claims here. Expose recovery/reassignment through authorized
product controls, not recurring direct database repair.

requirement_contracts.title: Safe adoption and traceability
requirement_contracts.text:
Census actual legacy/custom/demo/import
data before migration; never reinterpret a zero-value gift/task as nonfinancial
request or create historical acceptance from inferred data. Expand compatible
readers/constraints before enabling writers, qualify old/new combinations, and
quarantine ambiguous imports for accountable resolution. After new writes,
rollback SHALL preserve lawful request/history/effect identities and prohibit old
writers that cannot express them. Trace D22 clauses and acceptance evidence into
the glossary/PRD/OpenSpec/design/tasks/tickets/release record through their
canonical authoring sources when those workflows are invoked.

requirement_contracts.title: Honest measures
requirement_contracts.text:
Each measure SHALL state its grain, scope, period,
current-versus-historical meaning and coverage. A working-list Party count SHALL
exclude historical-only participation; a current Request-response count SHALL
count distinct Requests using the source-qualified current response to identified
terms. Contradictory or unresolved accounts remain clarification-required and
SHALL NOT count as confirmed agreement.
A supporter with several response types MAY occur in each corresponding distinct-
supporter set: those sets SHALL NOT be summed as disjoint. Event counts SHALL be
explicitly labelled; repeat edits or replies SHALL NOT inflate current agreements.
Unavailable, withheld, incomplete, nonapplicable and known zero SHALL remain
different. Hidden rows SHALL be excluded before counting; a permission-safe view
must not reveal their existence through a total, difference, rank or small group.

A response rate SHALL use an explicit compatible invitation population, never
today's smaller working list after removals. Zero/absent target, denied denominator
and incomplete coverage SHALL not produce a percentage. Over-target actuals remain
visible rather than clipped to the goal. Goal revisions preserve their earlier
versions; current adjusted results and a dated closure snapshot are distinct views.

requirement_contracts.title: Temporal and correction meaning
requirement_contracts.text:
Preserve occurred-at precision separately
from server recorded-at, presented terms, current effective response and source
correction history. Do not fabricate dates or backdate permissions. A late response
or imported event SHALL not create historical outreach or replay old tasks. Purpose,
goal, financial applicability and reference edits SHALL preserve prior versions;
hiding a financial section SHALL not delete gifts or silently submit hidden values.
Source-qualified Party merge SHALL preserve conflicting planning/response facts
and financial donor history; unresolved collisions remain visible to authorized
repair staff without revealing hidden records or creating duplicates.

requirement_contracts.title: Reviewer eligibility
requirement_contracts.text:
Required review SHALL have one current qualified
  internal reviewer or a visible source-owned recovery condition. Allowed self-review
  SHALL be deliberate; actual separation floors SHALL use stable person identity.

requirement_contracts.title: Deliberate lifecycle
requirement_contracts.text:
Submission, decision, withdrawal, reassignment,
  resubmission and prospective correction/revocation SHALL follow the lifecycle table,
  preserve history and never fabricate donor refusal or revive ended work.

requirement_contracts.title: Current applicability
requirement_contracts.text:
Future supported actions SHALL use current required
  review coverage and source authority. Policy changes SHALL preserve explicit choices
  and historical facts, and SHALL never automatically send. Unrelated routing changes
  or reviewer departure alone SHALL NOT invalidate an accepted decision.

requirement_contracts.title: Shared work
requirement_contracts.text:
Review and actionable recovery SHALL use registered source
  work and safe attention contracts. Generic task completion, notification read or
  timeout SHALL NOT decide; absent/indeterminate recipients SHALL release no fallback.

requirement_contracts.title: Minimal disclosure
requirement_contracts.text:
Reviewers SHALL receive a sufficient currently authorized
  view of relevant terms; protected bodies SHALL NOT be copied into general tasks,
  logs, messages, exports or caches without separately qualified exact projection.

requirement_contracts.title: Atomic acceptance and races
requirement_contracts.text:
Relevant current-head validation, terminal
  decision, mandatory local evidence, receipt and downstream intent SHALL commit
  atomically; conflicting edits/decisions/policy/authority changes SHALL have one
  coherent ordered result without stale clearance.

requirement_contracts.title: Durable retry
requirement_contracts.text:
Same business intent SHALL be idempotent across retries and
  deliveries; changed intent SHALL conflict; replay SHALL reauthorize its returned
  projection and SHALL NOT replace current truth with an old receipt.

requirement_contracts.title: History and correction
requirement_contracts.text:
Accepted decision identity, actor, scope, terms
  reference, policy basis, recorded time and later dispositions SHALL remain traceable
  under lawful retention. Corrections SHALL NOT rewrite accepted history; retention,
  redaction and restore SHALL not revive expired access or erased sensitive content.

requirement_contracts.title: Independent native operation
requirement_contracts.text:
The complete native flow SHALL work without
  Studio, external approval vendors, a second inbox, a rule builder or an invented
  timer. Optional orchestration SHALL consume the same source fact and effect identity.

requirement_contracts.title: Bounded operational qualification
requirement_contracts.text:
Tenant-scoped current lists, authorized
  counts, paginated history and source recovery SHALL have measured workload/query
  evidence, bounded retries and explicit operations ownership before release.

requirement_contracts.title: Safe rollout
requirement_contracts.text:
Capability/schema/reader/worker/owner-binding compatibility
  SHALL precede activation; old clients/imports SHALL not create approvals. A kill
  switch SHALL stop unsafe new decisions/actions without converting required review
  to optional or destroying truthful history.

requirement_contracts.title: Current applicability
requirement_contracts.text:
Future supported actions SHALL use current required
  review coverage and source authority. Policy changes SHALL preserve explicit choices
  and historical facts, and SHALL never automatically send. Unrelated routing changes
  or reviewer departure alone SHALL NOT invalidate an accepted decision.

requirement_contracts.title: Domain boundaries
requirement_contracts.text:
Internal review SHALL NOT mutate supporter responses,
  stage/lifecycle, commitments, receipts, consent, publication or booking truth. Their
  qualified owner gates SHALL remain independently enforced.

requirement_contracts.title: Historical truth
requirement_contracts.text:
Authorized past presentation/response entry SHALL remain
  available without invented approval, with truthful occurrence/recording evidence and
  known/unknown approval basis. It SHALL NOT authorize future outward action.

requirement_contracts.title: Shared work
requirement_contracts.text:
Review and actionable recovery SHALL use registered source
  work and safe attention contracts. Generic task completion, notification read or
  timeout SHALL NOT decide; absent/indeterminate recipients SHALL release no fallback.

requirement_contracts.title: Atomic acceptance and races
requirement_contracts.text:
Relevant current-head validation, terminal
  decision, mandatory local evidence, receipt and downstream intent SHALL commit
  atomically; conflicting edits/decisions/policy/authority changes SHALL have one
  coherent ordered result without stale clearance.

requirement_contracts.title: Clear accessible UI
requirement_contracts.text:
The shared interface SHALL show meaningful current
  state, exact review scope, responsible next actor, permitted next action and change
  path; preserve relevant input, announce outcomes and distinguish failed/unknown/
  restricted states. It SHALL satisfy the concrete UX/browser cases above.

requirement_contracts.title: History and correction
requirement_contracts.text:
Accepted decision identity, actor, scope, terms
  reference, policy basis, recorded time and later dispositions SHALL remain traceable
  under lawful retention. Corrections SHALL NOT rewrite accepted history; retention,
  redaction and restore SHALL not revive expired access or erased sensitive content.

requirement_contracts.title: Independent native operation
requirement_contracts.text:
The complete native flow SHALL work without
  Studio, external approval vendors, a second inbox, a rule builder or an invented
  timer. Optional orchestration SHALL consume the same source fact and effect identity.

requirement_contracts.title: Proof and traceability
requirement_contracts.text:
Decision→glossary→owner mapping→future requirements/
  design/tasks→implementation/test/release evidence SHALL stay consistent. Actual
  authorization, concurrency, accessibility and rollout cases below SHALL be proven
  before claiming implementation readiness.

requirement_contracts.title: Financial reporting
requirement_contracts.text:
Report requested, forecast, response, source
commitment and source received/adjusted outcomes separately with coverage and
as-of meaning. Nonfinancial requests SHALL NOT lower monetary averages or inflate
funding totals; optional amount queries SHALL NOT make them vanish from ordinary
request counts. Do not add mutually exclusive proposals, recognition and gifts,
different currencies/entities, or repeated source coverage into an unlabeled
total. Any allocation/fulfillment claim requires the owning contract, not a
date/amount/Party match or copied financial status.

requirement_contracts.title: Honest measures
requirement_contracts.text:
Each measure SHALL state its grain, scope, period,
current-versus-historical meaning and coverage. A working-list Party count SHALL
exclude historical-only participation; a current Request-response count SHALL
count distinct Requests using the source-qualified current response to identified
terms. Contradictory or unresolved accounts remain clarification-required and
SHALL NOT count as confirmed agreement.
A supporter with several response types MAY occur in each corresponding distinct-
supporter set: those sets SHALL NOT be summed as disjoint. Event counts SHALL be
explicitly labelled; repeat edits or replies SHALL NOT inflate current agreements.
Unavailable, withheld, incomplete, nonapplicable and known zero SHALL remain
different. Hidden rows SHALL be excluded before counting; a permission-safe view
must not reveal their existence through a total, difference, rank or small group.

A response rate SHALL use an explicit compatible invitation population, never
today's smaller working list after removals. Zero/absent target, denied denominator
and incomplete coverage SHALL not produce a percentage. Over-target actuals remain
visible rather than clipped to the goal. Goal revisions preserve their earlier
versions; current adjusted results and a dated closure snapshot are distinct views.

requirement_contracts.title: Financial truth
requirement_contracts.text:
P13 effective contribution lines, P14 qualified legal/
recognition lenses, P15 intake and P16 commitment/fulfillment SHALL remain the
authorities. A reference SHALL NOT allocate money or establish fulfillment. Every
amount SHALL retain Legal Entity, currency, amount basis, source identity, period
and freshness. Distinct source money SHALL be counted once within a financial
measure; overlapping appeal totals SHALL not be added as disjoint. No sum of legal
and recognition lenses, silent FX, invented valuation or gift inference from
names/dates/amounts/source code is allowed. Exact received-toward-appeal coverage
requires a qualified association adapter; otherwise label it unavailable while
retaining permitted source facts and ordinary nonfinancial work. Corrections,
returns and refunds SHALL change current derived outcomes through source truth,
without rewriting prior responses or adding another money writer.
Requested amounts, staff forecasts, supporter responses, commitments and received
money SHALL not be added together. Apply only admitted line/amount coverage, not
the full gift header because one portion is related. Preserve the qualified source
monetary basis, including admitted charitable fee cover and finalized corrections;
no processor-fee subtraction, expected gift, noncash valuation or liquidation
proceeds substitution. Readers SHALL use a coherent source/association/coverage
revision, not a maximum of unrelated per-record cursors.

requirement_contracts.title: Temporal and correction meaning
requirement_contracts.text:
Preserve occurred-at precision separately
from server recorded-at, presented terms, current effective response and source
correction history. Do not fabricate dates or backdate permissions. A late response
or imported event SHALL not create historical outreach or replay old tasks. Purpose,
goal, financial applicability and reference edits SHALL preserve prior versions;
hiding a financial section SHALL not delete gifts or silently submit hidden values.
Source-qualified Party merge SHALL preserve conflicting planning/response facts
and financial donor history; unresolved collisions remain visible to authorized
repair staff without revealing hidden records or creating duplicates.

requirement_contracts.title: Bounded reads and integrations
requirement_contracts.text:
Page/virtualize authorized lists with
stable server ordering; compute aggregates from the qualified complete source set,
not loaded pages or capped timelines. Avoid per-row source fan-out and loading all
financial/private children for an overview. Bounded bulk work uses durable checkpoints
and per-member outcomes. Optional Studio, scoring, event/publishing tools and provider
outages SHALL NOT block ordinary authorized nonfinancial work. Source-dependent
features fail visibly without a shadow substitute. Any optimization is a rebuildable
read model with its source cursor/coverage, never a second writer.

requirement_contracts.title: Evidence and operations
requirement_contracts.text:
Business history SHALL show who changed which
source terms, reference, response or disposition and when. Security audit tracks
authorized actions/access; technical logs track operation/correlation/source-version
IDs and failures without sensitive content. A saved authoritative response SHALL not
be lost because a projection failed; expose pending update and replay durable effects.
Release proof SHALL include real source services, real role/grant/RLS tests,
concurrent schedules, mixed-version migration and observed staff UX. Unknown workload
or usability cannot be replaced by a fabricated performance number or claim of
perfection. Every monitored residual has an owner, threshold and response below.

acceptance_source_text.AC27-P11-02: **Given** a relevant promise exists outside the first page or is protected from the actor, **when** closure readiness is evaluated, **then** complete owner evidence determines readiness; permitted minimal outcomes disclose only authorized information and unknown checks cannot pass as empty.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P11-03: **Given** an independent obligation has valid continuing authority and responsibility, **when** closure disposes the development-specific work, **then** the independent obligation stays findable and actionable; reassigning the same continuing development work does not falsely satisfy readiness.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P11-04: **Given** close races new work, review changes or authority revocation through any admitted writer, **when** real transactions exercise both orders, **then** no accepted combination strands required work or permits stale authority; closure and the incompatible new work cannot both pass separate stale prechecks.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P11-06: **Given** staff close one of several scoped relationships, **when** current views, counts and financial/contact sources are reconciled, **then** only that enrollment leaves current-work scope; the preserved stage, requests, assignments, gifts, consent and other enrollments are unchanged and no last-contact/successful-ask increment occurs.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P11-08: **Given** closed work is viewed under current permissions after redaction or lawful content deletion, **when** history and derived reports are opened, **then** the admitted structural history remains attributable without restoring forbidden content, changing closed-period interpretation or fabricating successful outcomes.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P08-05: **Given** a review action resumes or closes work, **when** the qualified source command commits, **then** affected obligations are explicitly accounted for; unrelated tasks, gifts, commitments, consent and public content remain unchanged.

Authorize before filter/count/sort/explain, minimize hidden-work reasons, and bind cached drafts/results to current tenant/viewer/purpose/generation. Recovery reauthorizes exact receipts; late callbacks cannot leak or overwrite another context. Retention/redaction/backup actions preserve lawful history without restoring deleted protected narrative. Register bounded source projections for qualified existing exports/brief/notifications, not a new export product.

acceptance: AC27-A09-03: Given some candidate staff, work, matching inputs and history are unavailable to the current viewer; When the viewer searches, filters, counts, orders, previews, explains, exports or consumes cached/derived assignment data; Then Target search, preview counts/differences, reasons, sorting, history, exports, caches, AI/briefs and notifications reveal no unauthorized people, work or rule inputs.

AC27-A09-04: Given a permitted preview, resumable draft or operation receipt exists; When Tenant context changes, permissions are revoked or the session expires before apply, result recovery, export or download; Then Tenant switch, revoked permission and expired session between preview and apply/download narrow or reject current output; cached drafts/receipts cannot leak or replay across tenants.

AC27-A11-03: Given a mobile or throttled connection and an authorized in-progress edit or transfer; When requests slow, responses arrive late or are lost, navigation/reconnect occurs and access is subsequently removed; Then Throttled/mobile and lost-response journeys keep essential context/actions usable, preserve permitted edits and reconcile without duplicate transfer; access loss clears disallowed local data.

AC27-A10-02: Given source history and diagnostics include assignment reasons and references to protected information; When logs, notifications, lawful exports, retention/redaction and backup recovery are exercised; Then Logs/notifications omit sensitive rule input and work content; lawful retention/redaction/export/backup recovery does not resurrect deleted protected text.

AC27-A14-02: Given the actual composed settings, ordered rules, preview and transfer/recovery interfaces are available; When keyboard and screen-reader users complete individual and finite-group workflows, including conflict and partial success; Then Keyboard/focus and screen-reader checks cover settings, ordering, previews, grouped apply, conflict, partial results and recovery; automated checks supplement manual verification.

AC27-A14-03: Given actual interfaces contain long Unicode names, translated and RTL labels and light/dark themes; When users zoom or work at applicable 320 CSS-pixel reflow and operate all controls by keyboard and touch; Then At applicable 320 CSS px reflow/zoom, long Unicode/RTL/translated names and labels stay readable; target sizes and light/dark contrast meet WCAG 2.2 AA without drag-only or color-only operation.

Keyboard/screen-reader, non-drag and 320px/zoom/touch/RTL/light-dark composed flows prove current state and recovery; denied/unknown/empty/stale/partial remain distinct. A missing picker result is not unassignment.

what_to_build: Extend the actual qualified P6/P32 producer-purpose admission path with exact continuing membership/no-exclusion and appeal-origin fences. A member change atomically advances the authoritative fence; no outbox-only safety update. Frozen send populations narrow without replacements. Different appeal/contact/purpose relabelling cannot bypass the original applicable restriction. Preserve independent receipts, service responses and fulfillment; appeal link alone is not dependence. Report dispatching/submitted/unknown outcomes truthfully and reconcile rather than recall or duplicate send. Return never resumes the ended solicitation occurrence; restore must reconcile later restrictions before source readers/workers resume.
context: The demo deliberately stalls all secondary projection workers while ordering exclusion versus actual dispatch in both directions. A native/Studio duplicate delivery converges on the same source effect; generalized email timing or automatic reminder rules are out of scope.
non_goals: No new generic workflow, event-sourcing, list, approval, financial or task engine.
acceptance: AC27-F43-01: Given membership-dependent solicitation waiting for dispatch admission, when racing Remove/Exclude against admission in both orders with secondary projection stalled, then Remove/exclude and membership-dependent solicitation admission race in both orders: earlier accepted invalidation blocks later admission even with the secondary projection worker unavailable; already-dispatching/submitted/indeterminate work remains truthful and reconciles. No recall claim.

AC27-F39-03: Given a frozen send population plus independent receipt, service and fulfillment work, when excluding a member, later returning it and trying purpose relabelling, then Source exclusion narrows a captured P32 send without adding replacements. Independently required responses/receipts/service or fulfillment remain under their owners, even with an appeal link. A later Return does not resume the ended solicitation occurrence; relabelling that purpose cannot bypass exclusion.

AC27-F45-01: Given accepted membership and duplicate or reordered worker events, when delivering secondary callbacks and recovering an uncertain provider result, then Delayed/duplicate/out-of-order worker and projection events preserve membership and exact effect identity. Failure of a secondary projection cannot falsify acceptance; provider uncertainty cannot trigger another send or list revival.

requirement_contracts.title: Separate facts
requirement_contracts.text:
Planned inclusion, current eligibility, actual requests,
  responses, commitment, received money and communication outcomes SHALL retain
  their distinct source meanings. Membership SHALL create none of the other facts.

requirement_contracts.title: Current restrictions
requirement_contracts.text:
New actionable inclusion and solicitation SHALL
  respect current applicable never-ask/contact restrictions. Existing history SHALL
  not be rewritten or erased to represent current restriction. Appeal exclusions
  SHALL NOT be used to modify global consent, or bypassed through alternate contacts
  representing the same excluded organization/purpose.

requirement_contracts.title: Atomic member outcomes
requirement_contracts.text:
Each accepted member effect, required local history,
  receipt and actual required producer-fence advancement/supersession SHALL be atomic
  through the qualified owner transaction. Only permitted secondary effects may be
  deferred through durable intent; a fence-update outbox alone is insufficient.
  Independent outcomes may be
  partial; accepted work SHALL survive other members' failures and cancellation.

requirement_contracts.title: Concurrency and idempotency
requirement_contracts.text:
Relevant expected heads and owner fences SHALL
  serialize competing state/authority changes. Same-intent retries SHALL not duplicate
  or reapply effects; changed intent SHALL conflict; old receipts SHALL not replace
  current membership. Ordinary Add SHALL not override a newer removal/exclusion.

requirement_contracts.title: Precise outward effect
requirement_contracts.text:
Solicitation whose qualified producer purpose
  depends on appeal working membership SHALL use continuing inclusion as a current
  producer predicate through P6/P32 before
  dispatch admission. Removal/exclusion SHALL fence affected not-yet-admitted work,
  preserve in-flight/unknown truth and never cancel independent owner work merely
  because it has an appeal link. Return
  SHALL not revive ended effects; absent adapter qualification SHALL block activation.

requirement_contracts.title: Existing work and historical facts
requirement_contracts.text:
List edits SHALL preserve actual
  requests/responses/financial facts. Historical entry remains possible without
  re-adding the Party. Source-backed tasks SHALL follow exact actionable predicates;
  membership, filter refresh and generic completion SHALL not start/end other facts.

requirement_contracts.title: Identity repair
requirement_contracts.text:
Merge/unmerge SHALL use owner-qualified identity repair,
  retained provenance and current restrictions. Conflicting applicable planning
  intentions SHALL not become silently actionable or double-counted; resolution is
  bounded to affected membership and respects later decisions.

requirement_contracts.title: Minimal governed data
requirement_contracts.text:
Store minimal classified membership/provenance and
  lawful history, with current source projections for contact detail. Manifests,
  reasons, logs, caches, exports and backups SHALL obey the same authority and
  disposal boundaries; no default contact-directory snapshot or protected payload copy.

requirement_contracts.title: Native bounded operation
requirement_contracts.text:
Planning SHALL work without Studio, external
  campaign providers, a new group/list engine or a task/reminder per entry. Consumers
  SHALL use exact qualified source identities and outcome contracts.

requirement_contracts.title: Measurement and operations
requirement_contracts.text:
Scoped lists/history, permission-safe counts,
  group execution, query plans, lock waits and reconciliation SHALL be measured
  against an explicit numeric admitted workload and named budgets before release.
  No undocumented silent caps or unmeasured capacity claim is permitted.

requirement_contracts.title: Safe upgrade and restore
requirement_contracts.text:
Additive schema, compatible writers/readers,
  current source fences and data census SHALL precede activation. Imports/backfills
  SHALL not invent planning intent or outreach; disabling a consumer SHALL not
  waive restrictions. Rollback/restore SHALL preserve new accepted history and
  re-prove current exclusion/identity/access/disposal before affected work resumes.

requirement_contracts.title: Stable scoped identity
requirement_contracts.text:
Each appeal SHALL have at most one current entry
  for the same qualified Party in its Tenant/source scope, with complete scoped
  references and retained provenance. Organizations SHALL NOT expand into recipients
  and weak matching SHALL NOT merge distinct people or organizations.

requirement_contracts.title: Deliberate dispositions
requirement_contracts.text:
Add, Remove, Exclude and Return SHALL follow the
  lifecycle table. Plain Add/import/retry SHALL skip retained removed/excluded
  entries; only an explicit currently authorized Return may restore inclusion.

requirement_contracts.title: Current restrictions
requirement_contracts.text:
New actionable inclusion and solicitation SHALL
  respect current applicable never-ask/contact restrictions. Existing history SHALL
  not be rewritten or erased to represent current restriction. Appeal exclusions
  SHALL NOT be used to modify global consent, or bypassed through alternate contacts
  representing the same excluded organization/purpose.

requirement_contracts.title: Concurrency and idempotency
requirement_contracts.text:
Relevant expected heads and owner fences SHALL
  serialize competing state/authority changes. Same-intent retries SHALL not duplicate
  or reapply effects; changed intent SHALL conflict; old receipts SHALL not replace
  current membership. Ordinary Add SHALL not override a newer removal/exclusion.

requirement_contracts.title: Precise outward effect
requirement_contracts.text:
Solicitation whose qualified producer purpose
  depends on appeal working membership SHALL use continuing inclusion as a current
  producer predicate through P6/P32 before
  dispatch admission. Removal/exclusion SHALL fence affected not-yet-admitted work,
  preserve in-flight/unknown truth and never cancel independent owner work merely
  because it has an appeal link. Return
  SHALL not revive ended effects; absent adapter qualification SHALL block activation.

requirement_contracts.title: Identity repair
requirement_contracts.text:
Merge/unmerge SHALL use owner-qualified identity repair,
  retained provenance and current restrictions. Conflicting applicable planning
  intentions SHALL not become silently actionable or double-counted; resolution is
  bounded to affected membership and respects later decisions.

requirement_contracts.title: Minimal governed data
requirement_contracts.text:
Store minimal classified membership/provenance and
  lawful history, with current source projections for contact detail. Manifests,
  reasons, logs, caches, exports and backups SHALL obey the same authority and
  disposal boundaries; no default contact-directory snapshot or protected payload copy.

requirement_contracts.title: Safe upgrade and restore
requirement_contracts.text:
Additive schema, compatible writers/readers,
  current source fences and data census SHALL precede activation. Imports/backfills
  SHALL not invent planning intent or outreach; disabling a consumer SHALL not
  waive restrictions. Rollback/restore SHALL preserve new accepted history and
  re-prove current exclusion/identity/access/disposal before affected work resumes.

requirement_contracts.title: Scope and composition
requirement_contracts.text:
P27 SHALL own one appeal coordination identity
and purpose. It SHALL reuse D24 membership and D22 Requests for financial,
nonfinancial and mixed support. It SHALL NOT require money or a numerical goal,
create a second request subtype per surface, or add an event, prayer-content,
volunteer, generic workflow or campaign-management engine.

requirement_contracts.title: Authority at every boundary
requirement_contracts.text:
The server SHALL derive tenant and actor
from trusted context; prove proposed owner, subject, source and purpose eligibility;
and reject caller-authored audit, approval, presentation or financial authority.
Appeal administration SHALL NOT grant finance, source Request, care, location,
missionary or historical access. Commands SHALL revalidate current authority and
expected revisions at their mutation boundary. Imports, jobs, RPCs, privileged
service paths, caches, search, exports, generated documents, briefs/AI and
notifications SHALL preserve the same field/purpose restrictions. D26's narrow
shared-update grant SHALL NOT become an appeal-audience grant.

requirement_contracts.title: Real work and source effects
requirement_contracts.text:
Reuse ADR0183
and ADR0027.
Create work only for a proved actionable source occurrence, with eligible
responsibility and defined end semantics. Appeal membership, a new link, a response
or an ongoing agreement to pray SHALL NOT automatically create one task per person
or perpetual check-ins. Native and optional workflows SHALL use one durable
source-purpose identity; linking the source into another appeal SHALL not create
another task, notification or delivery. Independent actual obligations remain.

requirement_contracts.title: Lifecycle and closure
requirement_contracts.text:
Distinguish preparation, active coordination and
closed coordination, with cancellation recorded as an honest closing disposition;
archive is a view/retention operation, not source deletion. Close SHALL atomically
fence new appeal-originated planning/solicitation and record lawful treatment or
durable owner handoff for affected work. Do not claim downstream completion before
it occurs. If authority or required disposition is missing, preserve current state
and expose an owned repair path. Late facts and corrections remain recordable
against prior terms; closure does not authorize new outreach or silently reopen.
Reopen SHALL preserve closure history and require fresh, deliberate new work.
Removing the last member or reaching a goal SHALL NOT automatically close anything.

requirement_contracts.title: Correctness under concurrency
requirement_contracts.text:
A mutation SHALL atomically persist its
authoritative intent, lawful history and required durable effect intent, or none.
Use semantic idempotency tied to the actual operation, not only an HTTP retry.
Identical retries return the same lawful result; stale competing edits conflict
without overwriting newer terms or responses. Link/unlink, close/reopen, merge,
suppression/revocation and dispatch races SHALL use current revisions/fences with
defined ordering. Cancellation of a finite bulk operation retains committed members
and truthfully identifies unattempted/failed ones. Lost responses and ambiguous
external success reconcile through the existing owner before resending. No unproved
exactly-once claim across external providers.

requirement_contracts.title: Temporal and correction meaning
requirement_contracts.text:
Preserve occurred-at precision separately
from server recorded-at, presented terms, current effective response and source
correction history. Do not fabricate dates or backdate permissions. A late response
or imported event SHALL not create historical outreach or replay old tasks. Purpose,
goal, financial applicability and reference edits SHALL preserve prior versions;
hiding a financial section SHALL not delete gifts or silently submit hidden values.
Source-qualified Party merge SHALL preserve conflicting planning/response facts
and financial donor history; unresolved collisions remain visible to authorized
repair staff without revealing hidden records or creating duplicates.

requirement_contracts.title: Coherent accessible interface
requirement_contracts.text:
The daily experience above SHALL preserve
shared design-system ownership, visible context, clear next actions, explicit
selection scope and truthful save/error/conflict feedback. Require WCAG 2.2 AA for
the composed flow, including keyboard/focus operation, text status announcements,
contrast, reflow and target size; do not mistake a shared primitive or axe pass for
complete accessibility. No drag-only financial/status mutation, compulsory wizard,
new dashboard language or donor-value rating. Current scope and relevant options
must be understandable without documentation or facilitator correction.

requirement_contracts.title: Safe delivery and rollout
requirement_contracts.text:
Census retained records and active readers/
writers first; do not reinterpret legacy zero-valued gifts, campaign rows, task
completion or member statuses as nonfinancial outcomes. Preserve unknown historical
meaning. Introduce qualified readers/constraints before enabling writers and reject
incompatible old-client mutations. Backfills SHALL be resumable/idempotent and
produce no outward effects. Activate by bounded tenant/cohort with kill switches
for new writes/effects; rollback SHALL retain newly recorded history and favor
compatible reads/roll-forward over destructive downgrade. Reconcile formal owner
clauses and trace their tests before activation.

requirement_contracts.title: Evidence and operations
requirement_contracts.text:
Business history SHALL show who changed which
source terms, reference, response or disposition and when. Security audit tracks
authorized actions/access; technical logs track operation/correlation/source-version
IDs and failures without sensitive content. A saved authoritative response SHALL not
be lost because a projection failed; expose pending update and replay durable effects.
Release proof SHALL include real source services, real role/grant/RLS tests,
concurrent schedules, mixed-version migration and observed staff UX. Unknown workload
or usability cannot be replaced by a fabricated performance number or claim of
perfection. Every monitored residual has an owner, threshold and response below.

monitors.response: Trace source gap, remove duplicate step or repair the authoritative workflow, then verify with affected staff.

acceptance_source_text.AC27-P21-05:
**Given** The specified assessed, unassessed, retired, unavailable or restricted source facts.
**When** admission, assessment, read, grouping or serialization is exercised.
**Then** every stated observable result and invariant below SHALL hold, with the specified fixtures and boundary cases included in verification:

Compare pagination, list, offered board, filters, counts and exports for the same declared scope with unassessed, assessed, retired, denied and failed-coverage fixtures. No implicit stage join drops work; unknown/partial totals are not zero. After first assessment, a filtered row's removal has truthful success and usable focus. A board shall not clear a stage merely by applying a null patch; any offered clearing interaction shall express the deliberate reviewed consequence and use REQ27-P28's qualified source command.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P28-01: **Given** an authorized partnership has a current stage, **when** staff deliberately choose no current stage and save, **then** the current and proposed meanings are clear before Save; the same partnership/list now shows Not yet assessed and an available Set stage action, with earlier assessment retained.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P28-02: **Given** a tenant stage is named Not yet assessed or equivalent, **when** staff inspect or choose absence, **then** the configured stage and actual no-current-assessment option remain distinguishable by meaning and stable identity.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P28-03: **Given** a request omits stage or the current value is denied, unloaded or unavailable, **when** another edit is saved or a callback arrives, **then** the source current stage is not cleared and the UI never substitutes unknown coverage for accepted absence.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P28-05: **Given** a successful clear has been followed by a newer assessment, **when** the old command is retried after response loss, **then** the original receipt may be returned under current authority but the newer assessment remains.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P28-06: **Given** the source already has current absence, **when** the same-value command is submitted, **then** current authority/version checks still apply and no new assessment, transition timestamp, activity or duplicated history is created.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P28-07: **Given** the same binding belongs to a withdrawn retained list, **when** staff deliberately clear its assessment, **then** the binding stays usable under retained-work rules and no forced list migration or loss of past assessments occurs.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P28-08: **Given** the cleared work is closed then genuinely reopened, **when** the recorded state is reconstructed, **then** current absence remains; history is neither erased nor used as a last-non-null fallback.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P28-09: **Given** current-stage filters, boards, counts and exports include the cleared work, **when** authorized results are recomputed, **then** the work remains represented in the no-current-stage meaning without fake stage entry, last contact, gift or financial outcome.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P28-10: **Given** staff use keyboard, screen reader, touch or a weak connection to clear, **when** save succeeds, fails or returns an uncertain outcome, **then** input, current/proposed meaning, error/status and safe recovery remain understandable without required essay, second acknowledgment or invented follow-up.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P29-02: **Given** paused work has an assessment or uses a withdrawn retained list, **when** authorized staff clear the assessment or continue using an eligible retained stage, **then** the deliberate change succeeds under its source rules without mandatory list migration, resuming or completing the review.

From each offered native/API/reviewed-group admission path, valid known-stage and valid no-stage intent both succeed under D4. One deliberate commit suffices; no mandatory placeholder, note, extra confirmation or invented stage event. Required work/accountability and usable catalog remain.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P21-04:
**Given** The specified assessed, unassessed, retired, unavailable or restricted source facts.
**When** admission, assessment, read, grouping or serialization is exercised.
**Then** every stated observable result and invariant below SHALL hold, with the specified fixtures and boundary cases included in verification:

New-start omission is allowed. Updating another field does not clear a stage. Generic clear/delete/upsert or incidental explicit null cannot substitute for the deliberate same-list clearing command required by REQ27-P28. Known-stage intent from one reviewed member is not replaced by group fallback/default.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P24-07:
**Given** The specified valid and adversarial source states, revisions and durable intents.
**When** the actual mutation protocol runs through the stated races, retries or injected failures.
**Then** every stated observable result and invariant below SHALL hold, with the specified fixtures and boundary cases included in verification:

Given an editor at revision n/X and source changes X→Y→X at n+2, its stale write is rejected/reconciled despite matching X. Reopen retains the last authoritative stage under D9, including retired/unknown history, without a fabricated new assessment.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P24-10:
**Given** The specified valid and adversarial source states, revisions and durable intents.
**When** the actual mutation protocol runs through the stated races, retries or injected failures.
**Then** every stated observable result and invariant below SHALL hold, with the specified fixtures and boundary cases included in verification:

Competing stage assignments with the same expected revision produce one accepted change and a safe stale result. Retirement, revocation and closed-state changes before acceptance are checked. Same accepted intent replays without a new event; a different normalized payload under the same intent key conflicts. A genuinely new deliberate intent uses its own identity and current expected revision; a missing required revision is not treated as an unconditional update.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P15-01:
**Given** A list with the specified active or retired definitions and existing references.
**When** retirement, restoration, concurrent last-stage edits or retained-reference use is attempted.
**Then** every stated observable result and invariant below SHALL hold, with the specified fixtures and boundary cases included in verification:

Retire an in-use stage across active/paused/closed journeys. New selections fail; existing authorized detail, board, filters and counts retain the records. Task/owner edits and D9 reopening still work without stage reassessment. Explicit restore preserves identity/history and revives no ended work.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P15-03:
**Given** A list with the specified active or retired definitions and existing references.
**When** retirement, restoration, concurrent last-stage edits or retained-reference use is attempted.
**Then** every stated observable result and invariant below SHALL hold, with the specified fixtures and boundary cases included in verification:

Reopen with an unchanged retired stage and unknown provenance date; retain both without a new assessment. Fresh retired selection fails. Same-value no-op, renamed guidance and locale changes do not create transitions or reset dates. Qualified historical corrections/imports retain their separate treatment.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P26-01:
**Given** The stated stage/list operation and independently owned work, financial, communication and participation facts.
**When** acceptance, projection, optional integration or retry occurs.
**Then** every stated observable result and invariant below SHALL hold, with the specified fixtures and boundary cases included in verification:

Add/select/retire/reorder stages with lifecycle-, finance-, consent- and task-like names. No money, pledge, participation, consent, closure, task or donor-message effect occurs merely from those labels/configuration. Existing D6 follow-up and D7/D8 lifecycle remain independently correct; Studio may be off.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P18-13:
**Given** The stated authorized choice set, new-work draft or existing ordinary partnership.
**When** choice, admission, reuse or a reviewed-group member is processed.
**Then** every stated observable result and invariant below SHALL hold, with the specified fixtures and boundary cases included in verification:

Submit concrete A and lose the response, then change organization default to B: retry/group execution preserves original normalized A intent and reconciles one result. Omitted list is not “use latest default.” Each reviewed member retains current authorization and its own truthful acceptance/reuse outcome.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P17-05:
**Given** Available or withdrawn lists and the stated existing, returning or proposed work.
**When** new-use availability changes or admission/continued-use operations are exercised.
**Then** every stated observable result and invariant below SHALL hold, with the specified fixtures and boundary cases included in verification:

Resume/reopen the same eligible journey on its withdrawn list: current source binding and stage/absence survive; later stage choice works. Prior ended tasks remain ended. Current permission/return requirements still apply.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P24-15:
**Given** The specified valid and adversarial source states, revisions and durable intents.
**When** the actual mutation protocol runs through the stated races, retries or injected failures.
**Then** every stated observable result and invariant below SHALL hold, with the specified fixtures and boundary cases included in verification:

Controlled admission-first and withdrawal-first interleavings produce respectively retained existing work or rejected new use, never an accepted post-withdrawal attachment. Stale form, background retry, copied IDs, backdated input and future switch-back cannot bypass the rule. In one fixed reviewed group, preserve already accepted members, allow qualified current-bound reuse, reject unaccepted new members after withdrawal and reconcile uncertain receipts; review/enqueue is not admission, and retry never expands or retargets the group.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P28-04: **Given** clear races another stage change, list switch, close or authority loss, **when** both valid source orderings are exercised, **then** one permitted outcome commits atomically and stale input cannot erase or retarget the newer assessment/binding.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P12-03: **Given** the current stage was explicitly cleared before closure, **when** staff reopen, **then** Not yet assessed remains the authoritative absence; the last historical non-null stage is not reinstated.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P12-04: **Given** the current recorded stage is historical or retired, **when** staff reopen, **then** it remains understandable as previously recorded with genuine provenance, without fabricated new assessment/contact time or forced mapping.
acceptance_source_text.AC27-P12-05: **Given** a concurrent authorized stage update or a later close wins before a stale reopen/retry, **when** the older request arrives, **then** it cannot overwrite the newer stage or reopen the work again; one authorized cycle outcome remains.

command_caveats: Command names/syntax verified in root package.json, testing rulebook and Vitest skill; no runtime tests were run during this read-only ticketing subtask. Parent must integrate a reproducible real-source/auth/race fixture invocation; current mock/default CI is insufficient.

operating_monitors.signal: Accepted mismatched list/stage, changed journey identity/purpose or duplicate enrollment from a switch
operating_monitors.response: Contain the switching writer, preserve evidence/current safe reads, reconcile affected work through authorized source repair and regression-test all affected doors.

operating_monitors.signal: Protected old/target/history/context disclosed through UI, errors, cache, export or logs
operating_monitors.response: Contain revealing path, use existing incident process and verify minimum projection/context isolation before re-enabling.

operating_monitors.signal: Old accepted retry overwrites newer binding, or one intended change duplicates history/required effects
operating_monitors.response: Stop defective mutation/replay consumer, reconcile by durable intent and source ordering; fix and retest concurrency/retry.

operating_monitors.signal: Accepted change has missing required owner effect or unresolved source-result reconciliation
operating_monitors.owner: P27 source owner and shared work/delivery owner as applicable
operating_monitors.response: Recover the existing durable effect, never issue a replacement enrollment; diagnose acceptance/consumer seam before resuming affected path.

operating_monitors.signal: Staff cannot explain stage consequence or mistake the change for starting over/erasing history
operating_monitors.threshold: Any validated support report or observed usability failure
operating_monitors.response: Reproduce, correct copy/interaction and resulting records through qualified recovery; retest with representative users.

operating_monitors.signal: Accepted binding/history/result inconsistency, invalid scope/list pair, or duplicate accepted occurrence
operating_monitors.response: Stop affected writes, preserve receipts/evidence, diagnose and repair through source; requalify before enabling.

operating_monitors.signal: Unauthorized disclosure, hidden-as-unassessed classification or cross-tenant result
operating_monitors.owner: P12 security owner with P27 owner
operating_monitors.response: Contain affected route/projection, follow incident procedure, correct policy and re-run actual-role negative proofs.

operating_monitors.signal: Portfolio reconciliation mismatch for the same fully authorized population and source version
operating_monitors.owner: P33 reporting owner with P27 source owner
operating_monitors.response: Mark affected measure unavailable; fix projection/null semantics and rebuild from source without altering assessments.

operating_monitors.signal: A required effect accepted but not reconciled, or an operation result persistently unresolved
operating_monitors.threshold: Beyond the existing owning effect/recovery contract's deadline; if none exists, that reached effect cannot be enabled until one is defined
operating_monitors.owner: Shared work/effect owner and P27 on-call
operating_monitors.response: Reconcile by durable intent, show owned exception, do not replay the business change or create duplicate work.

operating_monitors.signal: Confirmed staff confusion causing unintended no-stage save, lost draft, or inability to find Set stage
operating_monitors.threshold: Any reproduced user-impacting case in pilot/support
operating_monitors.response: Inspect the actual flow, correct wording/state/controls and re-run affected usability/accessibility scenarios; no automatic guessed stage.

operating_monitors.signal: Surface/query latency or error-budget violation
operating_monitors.threshold: The explicit measured budget agreed for that surface before release
operating_monitors.response: Inspect scoped query plans/cohort and regression, repair access path/rendering; no speculative cache or loosening authorization.
